  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    template: null
    mathjax: null
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    anchor_sections: false
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars-tex_math_single_backslash"
params:
  input_a: "examples/report-a.Rmd"
  input_b: "examples/report-b.Rmd"
  exclusion_file: ""
  reference_file: ""
  max_evidence: 10
  text_k: 5
  text_min_chars: 30
  text_min_similarity: 0.8
  formula_min_steps: 2
  formula_max_steps: 5
  formula_max_skips: 1
  code_min_tokens: 20
  code_window_tokens: 100
  code_max_skips: 1

# BEGIN R/parser.R
# Rmd structural parser. Base R only; never evaluates input or YAML.

rmd_empty_units <- function() {
  data.frame(unit_id = character(), file_id = character(), type = character(),
    context_id = character(), section = character(), language = character(),
    start_offset = integer(), end_offset = integer(), start_line = integer(),
    start_column = integer(), end_line = integer(), end_column = integer(),
    content_start = integer(), content_end = integer(), raw = character(),
    content = character(), status = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

rmd_empty_diagnostics <- function() {
  data.frame(code = character(), severity = character(), line = integer(),
    column = integer(), message = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

parse_rmd_text <- function(text, file_id = "document") {
  if (!is.character(text) || length(text) != 1L || is.na(text))
    stop("text must be one non-missing character string.")
  if (!is.character(file_id) || length(file_id) != 1L || is.na(file_id) || !nzchar(file_id))
    stop("file_id must be one non-empty string.")
  # All positions refer to this normalized source, not to original bytes.
  source <- gsub("\r\n?", "\n", enc2utf8(text), perl = TRUE)
  source <- sub("^\ufeff", "", source)
  n <- nchar(source, type = "chars")
  chars <- if (n) strsplit(source, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]] else character()
  line_starts <- c(1L, which(chars == "\n") + 1L)
  units <- list(); diagnostics <- list(); context <- 0L; section <- ""
  cut <- function(a, b) if (a > b || a > n || b < 1L) "" else substr(source, a, b)
  pos <- function(k) {
    li <- findInterval(k, line_starts)
    c(as.integer(li), as.integer(k - line_starts[li] + 1L))
  }
  add_diag <- function(code, at, message, severity = "warning") {
    p <- pos(at)
    diagnostics[[length(diagnostics) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(code = code,
      severity = severity, line = p[1L], column = p[2L], message = message,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  new_context <- function() { context <<- context + 1L }
  emit <- function(type, a, b, ca = a, cb = b, language = "", status = "ok") {
    if (a > b) return(invisible(NULL))
    p <- pos(a); q <- pos(b)
    units[[length(units) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
      unit_id = sprintf("u%05d", length(units) + 1L), file_id = file_id,
      type = type, context_id = sprintf("p%05d", context), section = section,
      language = language, start_offset = as.integer(a), end_offset = as.integer(b),
      start_line = p[1L], start_column = p[2L], end_line = q[1L], end_column = q[2L],
      content_start = as.integer(ca), content_end = as.integer(cb), raw = cut(a, b),
      content = cut(ca, cb), status = status, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  starts <- function(at, token) identical(cut(at, at + nchar(token) - 1L), token)
  escaped <- function(at) {
    j <- at - 1L; count <- 0L
    while (j >= 1L && chars[j] == "\\") { count <- count + 1L; j <- j - 1L }
    count %% 2L == 1L
  }
  run_length <- function(at, ch) {
    j <- at
    while (j <= n && chars[j] == ch) j <- j + 1L
    j - at
  }
  line_end <- function(at) {
    li <- findInterval(at, line_starts)
    if (li < length(line_starts)) line_starts[li + 1L] - 2L else n
  }
  after_line <- function(end) min(end + 2L, n + 1L)
  find_close <- function(from, token, limit = n, exact_backticks = FALSE) {
    j <- from; size <- nchar(token)
    while (j + size - 1L <= limit) {
      if (starts(j, token) && (exact_backticks || !escaped(j))) {
        if (!exact_backticks ||
            (run_length(j, "`") == size && (j == 1L || chars[j - 1L] != "`")))
          return(j)
      }
      j <- j + 1L
    }
    NA_integer_
  }
  # Inline link/image destinations use balanced parentheses; no external reads.
  link_end <- function(at, limit) {
    label_start <- at + if (starts(at, "![")) 2L else 1L
    j <- label_start
    while (j <= limit && !(chars[j] == "]" && !escaped(j))) j <- j + 1L
    if (j > limit || !starts(j + 1L, "(")) return(NULL)
    depth <- 1L; k <- j + 2L
    while (k <= limit) {
      if (!escaped(k)) {
        if (chars[k] == "(") depth <- depth + 1L
        if (chars[k] == ")") depth <- depth - 1L
        if (depth == 0L) return(c(k, label_start, j - 1L))
      }
      k <- k + 1L
    }
    NULL
  }
  i <- 1L; pending <- NA_integer_
  flush <- function(before) {
    if (!is.na(pending)) {
      kind <- if (nzchar(trimws(cut(pending, before - 1L)))) "text" else "blank"
      emit(kind, pending, before - 1L)
      pending <<- NA_integer_
    }
  }
  while (i <= n) {
    at_line_start <- i == 1L || chars[i - 1L] == "\n"
    end <- line_end(i)
    line <- cut(i, end)
    if (at_line_start) {
      # Header recognized only at the beginning, never interpreted as YAML.
      if (i == 1L && grepl("^---[ \t]*$", line)) {
        flush(i); new_context(); j <- after_line(end); closing <- NA_integer_
        while (j <= n) {
          e <- line_end(j)
          if (grepl("^(---|\\.\\.\\.)[ \t]*$", cut(j, e))) { closing <- j; break }
          j <- after_line(e)
        }
        if (is.na(closing)) {
          emit("yaml", i, n, after_line(end), n, status = "limited")
          add_diag("unclosed_yaml", i, "YAML header is not closed; remaining source retained as limited YAML.")
          i <- n + 1L
        } else {
          e <- line_end(closing)
          emit("yaml", i, e, after_line(end), closing - 2L)
          i <- e + 1L
        }
        new_context(); next
      }
      fence <- regexec("^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$", line, perl = TRUE)
      hit <- regmatches(line, fence)[[1L]]
      if (length(hit)) {
        flush(i); new_context(); marker <- substr(hit[2L], 1L, 1L)
        width <- nchar(hit[2L]); info <- trimws(hit[3L])
        language <- if (grepl("^\\{[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_+-]*", info)) {
          sub("^\\{([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_+-]*).*", "\\1", info)
        } else if (grepl("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_+-]*", info)) {
          sub("^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_+-]*).*", "\\1", info)
        } else ""
        j <- after_line(end); closing <- NA_integer_
        pattern <- paste0("^ {0,3}", marker, "{", width, ",}[ \t]*$")
        while (j <= n) {
          e <- line_end(j)
          if (grepl(pattern, cut(j, e), perl = TRUE)) { closing <- j; break }
          j <- after_line(e)
        }
        status <- if (is.na(closing)) "limited" else "ok"
        if (is.na(closing)) {
          emit("code", i, n, after_line(end), n, language, status)
          add_diag("unclosed_fence", i, "Code fence not closed; remaining source retained as code.")
          i <- n + 1L
        } else {
          e <- line_end(closing)
          emit("code", i, e, after_line(end), closing - 2L, language, status)
          i <- e + 1L
        }
        if (tolower(language) != "r") add_diag("code_language_limited", units[[length(units)]]$start_offset,
          "Unlabelled or non-R code retained; later stages may only compare text.", "info")
        new_context(); next
      }
      if (grepl("^ {0,3}#{1,6}([ \t]+|$)", line, perl = TRUE)) {
        flush(i); new_context()
        section <- trimws(sub("[ \t]+#+[ \t]*$", "", sub("^ {0,3}#{1,6}[ \t]*", "", line)))
        emit("heading", i, end); i <- end + 1L; new_context(); next
      }
      if (grepl("^[ \t]*$", line)) {
        flush(i)
        b <- if (end < n) end + 1L else end
        emit("blank", i, b); i <- b + 1L; new_context(); next
      }
      if (grepl("^( {4}|\t)", line))
        add_diag("indentation_ambiguous", i, "Indented Markdown blocks are retained as text; use fenced code for reliable classification.")
    }
    if (starts(i, "<!--") && !escaped(i)) {
      flush(i); close <- find_close(i + 4L, "-->")
      b <- if (is.na(close)) n else close + 2L
      emit("unsupported", i, b, status = "limited")
      add_diag("html_comment", i, "HTML comment retained but excluded from comparable content.", "info")
      if (is.na(close)) add_diag("unclosed_html_comment", i, "HTML comment is not closed.")
      i <- b + 1L; next
    }
    if (chars[i] == "<" && !escaped(i) && grepl("^</?[A-Za-z]", cut(i, min(n, i + 20L)))) {
      flush(i)
      # Keep script/style bodies out of prose, even when they span lines.
      tag <- regmatches(cut(i, n), regexpr("^<(script|style)([[:space:]>])", cut(i, n), ignore.case = TRUE))
      b <- end
      if (length(tag) && nzchar(tag)) {
        name <- sub("^<([A-Za-z]+).*", "\\1", tolower(tag))
        rest <- cut(i + nchar(tag), n)
        closing <- regexpr(paste0("</", name, "[ \t]*>"), rest, ignore.case = TRUE)
        b <- if (closing[1L] < 0L) n else i + nchar(tag) + closing[1L] + attr(closing, "match.length") - 2L
      }
      emit("unsupported", i, b, status = "limited")
      add_diag("raw_html", i, "Raw HTML line retained; embedded content is not structurally analysed.")
      i <- b + 1L; next
    }
    if (!escaped(i) && (starts(i, "![") || chars[i] == "[")) {
      lk <- link_end(i, end)
      if (!is.null(lk)) {
        flush(i); image <- starts(i, "![")
        emit(if (image) "unsupported" else "text", i, lk[1L], lk[2L], lk[3L],
          status = if (image) "limited" else "ok")
        if (image) add_diag("image_not_read", i, "Image reference recorded; image content is not read.")
        i <- lk[1L] + 1L; next
      }
      if (starts(i, "![")) add_diag("image_syntax_limited", i,
        "Reference-style or complex image syntax is not extracted; retained as text.")
    }
    if (chars[i] == "`" && !escaped(i)) {
      flush(i); size <- run_length(i, "`"); token <- strrep("`", size)
      close <- find_close(i + size, token, end, TRUE)
      if (is.na(close)) {
        emit("unsupported", i, end, status = "limited")
        add_diag("unclosed_inline_code", i, "Inline code is not closed on this line; retained without evaluation.")
        i <- end + 1L
      } else {
        a <- i + size; b <- close - 1L; body <- cut(a, b)
        is_r <- grepl("^r[ \t]+", body)
        if (is_r) a <- a + nchar(regmatches(body, regexpr("^r[ \t]+", body)))
        emit(if (is_r) "inline_r" else "inline_code", i, close + size - 1L, a, b,
          language = if (is_r) "r" else "")
        i <- close + size
      }
      next
    }
    opener <- ""; closer <- ""; display <- FALSE
    if (!escaped(i)) {
      if (starts(i, "$$")) { opener <- "$$"; closer <- "$$"; display <- TRUE
      } else if (chars[i] == "$" && i < n && !grepl("[[:space:]]", chars[i + 1L])) {
        opener <- "$"; closer <- "$"
      } else if (starts(i, "\\(")) { opener <- "\\("; closer <- "\\)"
      } else if (starts(i, "\\[")) { opener <- "\\["; closer <- "\\]"; display <- TRUE
      } else if (starts(i, "\\begin{")) {
        env <- regmatches(cut(i, n), regexpr("^\\\\begin\\{[A-Za-z*]+\\}", cut(i, n)))
        if (length(env) && nzchar(env)) {
          name <- sub("^\\\\begin\\{([^}]+)\\}$", "\\1", env)
          if (name %in% c("equation", "equation*", "align", "align*", "gather", "gather*", "multline", "multline*")) {
            opener <- env; closer <- paste0("\\end{", name, "}"); display <- TRUE
          } else add_diag("latex_environment_limited", i, "Unsupported bare LaTeX environment retained as text.")
        }
      }
    }
    if (nzchar(opener)) {
      flush(i)
      close <- find_close(i + nchar(opener), closer, if (display) n else end)
      # A single-dollar closer must not be a display delimiter or follow whitespace.
      if (opener == "$") {
        while (!is.na(close) && (starts(close, "$$") ||
          (close > 1L && chars[close - 1L] == "$") ||
          grepl("[[:space:]]", chars[close - 1L])))
          close <- find_close(close + 1L, closer, end)
      }
      if (is.na(close)) {
        b <- if (display) n else end
        emit("math", i, b, i + nchar(opener), b, status = "limited")
        add_diag("unclosed_math", i, "Math delimiter is not closed within its supported scope; retained as limited math.")
        i <- b + 1L
      } else {
        emit("math", i, close + nchar(closer) - 1L, i + nchar(opener), close - 1L)
        i <- close + nchar(closer)
      }
      next
    }
    if (is.na(pending)) pending <- i
    i <- i + 1L
  }
  flush(n + 1L)
  if (n == 0L) add_diag("empty_document", 1L, "Document is empty.")
  u <- if (length(units)) do.call(rbind, units) else rmd_empty_units()
  d <- if (length(diagnostics)) do.call(rbind, diagnostics) else rmd_empty_diagnostics()
  structure(list(file_id = file_id, source = source, units = u, diagnostics = d,
    summary = list(characters = n, units = nrow(u), limited_units = sum(u$status == "limited"),
      text_units = sum(u$type == "text"), math_units = sum(u$type == "math"),
      code_units = sum(u$type %in% c("code", "inline_r")))), class = "rmd_document")
}

read_rmd <- function(path, file_id = basename(path), encoding = "UTF-8", keep_bytes = FALSE) {
  if (!is.character(path) || length(path) != 1L || is.na(path) || !nzchar(path))
    stop("path must be one non-empty local file path.")
  if (!file.exists(path) || dir.exists(path)) stop("Input file does not exist or is a directory: ", path)
  if (!grepl("\\.rmd$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) stop("Input must have an .Rmd extension.")
  con <- file(path, "rb"); on.exit(close(con))
  bytes <- readBin(con, "raw", n = file.info(path)$size)
  if (any(bytes == as.raw(0L))) stop("Input contains NUL bytes; choose a supported text encoding (not UTF-16).")
  raw_text <- rawToChar(bytes)
  text <- iconv(raw_text, from = encoding, to = "UTF-8", sub = NA)
  if (is.na(text)) stop("Input cannot be decoded with encoding=", encoding, "; specify the correct encoding.")
  result <- parse_rmd_text(text, file_id)
  result$encoding <- encoding
  if (keep_bytes) result$input_bytes <- bytes
  result
}
# END R/parser.R

# BEGIN R/text.R
# 从解析结果中提取可比较的正文单元
extract_text_units <- function(doc) {

  # 检查输入是否来自项目解析器
  if (!inherits(doc, "rmd_document")) {
    stop("doc must be an rmd_document returned by the parser.")
  }

  # 只选择已正常解析的正文
  selected <- doc$units$type == "text" &
    doc$units$status == "ok"

  # 保留全部字段，包括原文、位置和上下文
  doc$units[selected, , drop = FALSE]
}
# 去除空白，并记录每个保留字符在输入字符串中的位置
normalize_text <- function(text) {

  # 只接受一个非缺失字符串
  if (!is.character(text) ||
      length(text) != 1L ||
      is.na(text)) {
    stop("text must be one non-missing character string.")
  }

  # 拆成字符向量
  chars <- strsplit(
    enc2utf8(text),
    split = "",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1L]]

  # 本版本明确处理的空白字符
  whitespace <- c(
    " ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v",
    "\u00a0",  # 不换行空格
    "\u3000"   # 全角空格
  )

  # 哪些字符需要保留
  keep <- !(chars %in% whitespace)

  # 保留字符原本的位置
  source_positions <- seq_along(chars)[keep]

  list(
    text = paste0(chars[keep], collapse = ""),
    source_positions = source_positions
  )
}

# Identify removable Markdown characters without editing the source itself.
# Conservative subset: paired emphasis/strike, line prefixes and ASCII escapes.
markdown_drop_positions <- function(doc) {
  u <- extract_text_units(doc)
  chars <- strsplit(doc$source, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  n <- length(chars)
  if (!n || !nrow(u)) return(integer())
  eligible <- rep(FALSE, n)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(u))) {
    if (u$content_start[i] <= u$content_end[i])
      eligible[seq.int(u$content_start[i], u$content_end[i])] <- TRUE
  }
  drop <- rep(FALSE, n)
  # Protected content occupies its original width, but cannot supply delimiters.
  masked <- chars
  masked[!eligible & chars != "\n"] <- "\ufffc"
  escaped <- function(at) {
    j <- at - 1L; count <- 0L
    while (j >= 1L && chars[j] == "\\") { count <- count + 1L; j <- j - 1L }
    count %% 2L == 1L
  }
  ascii_punctuation <- c("!", "\"", "#", "$", "%", "&", "'", "(", ")", "*", "+", ",",
    "-", ".", "/", ":", ";", "<", "=", ">", "?", "@", "[", "\\", "]", "^", "_", "`", "{", "|", "}", "~")
  for (p in seq_len(n)) {
    if (eligible[p] && chars[p] == "\\" && !escaped(p) && p < n &&
        eligible[p + 1L] && chars[p + 1L] %in% ascii_punctuation)
      drop[p] <- TRUE
  }
  # Recognise quote/list prefixes only at real source line starts.
  starts <- c(1L, which(chars == "\n") + 1L)
  for (li in seq_along(starts)) {
    s <- starts[li]
    e <- if (li < length(starts)) starts[li + 1L] - 2L else n
    if (s > e) next
    used <- 0L
    repeat {
      p <- s + used
      if (p > e) break
      line <- paste0(masked[seq.int(p, e)], collapse = "")
      found <- regexpr("^ {0,3}(?:>[ \t]?|(?:[-+*]|[0-9]{1,9}[.)])[ \t]+)", line, perl = TRUE)
      if (found[1L] < 0L) break
      width <- attr(found, "match.length")
      ids <- seq.int(p, p + width - 1L)
      if (!all(eligible[ids])) break
      drop[ids] <- TRUE
      used <- used + width
    }
  }
  whitespace <- function(ch) ch %in% c(" ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v", "\u00a0", "\u3000")
  word <- function(ch) grepl("^[\\p{L}\\p{N}]$", ch, perl = TRUE)
  # Pair delimiters within the same paragraph context, including around protected
  # inline math/code, but never use delimiters from inside that protected content.
  for (indices in split(seq_len(nrow(u)), u$context_id)) {
    valid <- indices[u$content_start[indices] <= u$content_end[indices]]
    if (!length(valid)) next
    lo <- min(u$content_start[valid]); hi <- max(u$content_end[valid])
    stack <- list(); p <- lo
    while (p <= hi) {
      marker <- masked[p]
      if (!eligible[p] || drop[p] || !marker %in% c("*", "_", "~")) {
        p <- p + 1L; next
      }
      j <- p
      while (j <= hi && masked[j] == marker) j <- j + 1L
      width <- j - p
      supported <- if (marker == "~") width == 2L else width %in% 1:3
      if (!supported || escaped(p)) { p <- j; next }
      key <- paste0(marker, width)
      can_open <- j <= hi && !whitespace(masked[j])
      can_close <- p > lo && !whitespace(masked[p - 1L])
      if (marker == "_") {
        if (p > lo && word(masked[p - 1L])) can_open <- FALSE
        if (j <= hi && word(masked[j])) can_close <- FALSE
      }
      top <- length(stack)
      if (can_close && top > 0L && identical(stack[[top]]$key, key)) {
        opening <- stack[[top]]$positions
        drop[c(opening, seq.int(p, j - 1L))] <- TRUE
        stack <- stack[-top]
      } else if (can_open) {
        stack[[top + 1L]] <- list(key = key, positions = seq.int(p, j - 1L))
      }
      p <- j
    }
  }
  which(drop)
}

# 提取并规范化正文，将字符位置映射回文档
prepare_text_units <- function(doc) {

  units <- extract_text_units(doc)

  # 先排除已识别的排版标记，再去空白；始终保留原字符位置。
  dropped <- markdown_drop_positions(doc)
  normalized <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(units)), function(i) {
    chars <- strsplit(units$content[i], "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    positions <- as.integer(units$content_start[i] + seq_along(chars) - 1L)
    keep <- !positions %in% dropped
    result <- normalize_text(paste0(chars[keep], collapse = ""))
    list(text = result$text,
      source_positions = positions[keep][result$source_positions])
  })

  # 每个单元对应一个规范化字符串
  units$normalized_text <- vapply(
    normalized,
    function(item) item$text,
    character(1)
  )

  # 此处已经是文档位置；不能再次添加content_start。
  positions <- lapply(normalized, function(item) item$source_positions)

  # 每行保存长度可能不同的位置向量
  units$source_positions <- I(positions)

  units
}

# 将字符串切成固定长度的连续字符片段
make_character_ngrams <- function(text, k = 5L) {

  if (!is.character(text) ||
      length(text) != 1L ||
      is.na(text)) {
    stop("text must be one non-missing character string.")
  }

  # k必须是可表示的正整数
  if (!is.numeric(k) ||
      length(k) != 1L ||
      is.na(k) ||
      !is.finite(k) ||
      k < 1 ||
      k != floor(k) ||
      k > .Machine$integer.max) {
    stop("k must be a positive integer.")
  }

  k <- as.integer(k)
  text <- enc2utf8(text)
  n <- nchar(text, type = "chars")

  # 无法组成完整片段时，返回结构一致的空表
  if (n < k) {
    return(data.frame(
      gram = character(),
      start = integer(),
      end = integer(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  starts <- seq_len(n - k + 1L)
  ends <- starts + k - 1L

  data.frame(
    gram = substring(text, starts, ends),
    start = starts,
    end = ends,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# 为整份文档生成正文片段，并保留原文字符位置
make_document_ngrams <- function(doc, k = 5L) {

  units <- prepare_text_units(doc)

  # 即使没有正文，也要验证k，并建立稳定的空表结构
  empty_grams <- make_character_ngrams("", k = k)

  empty_result <- data.frame(
    file_id = character(),
    unit_id = character(),
    context_id = character(),
    gram = empty_grams$gram,
    normalized_start = empty_grams$start,
    normalized_end = empty_grams$end,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  empty_result$source_positions <- I(vector("list", 0L))

  parts <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(units))) {

    grams <- make_character_ngrams(
      units$normalized_text[i],
      k = k
    )

    # 当前单元太短时，不生成片段
    if (nrow(grams) == 0L) {
      next
    }

    part <- data.frame(
      file_id = units$file_id[i],
      unit_id = units$unit_id[i],
      context_id = units$context_id[i],
      gram = grams$gram,
      normalized_start = grams$start,
      normalized_end = grams$end,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # 从已有映射中取出每个片段对应的文档字符位置
    positions <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grams)), function(j) {
      indices <- seq.int(
        grams$start[j],
        grams$end[j]
      )

      units$source_positions[[i]][indices]
    })

    part$source_positions <- I(positions)

    parts[[length(parts) + 1L]] <- part
  }

  if (length(parts) == 0L) {
    return(empty_result)
  }

  result <- do.call(rbind, parts)
  rownames(result) <- NULL

  result
}

# 比较两份文档的正文字符片段集合
compare_text_jaccard <- function(doc_a, doc_b, k = 5L) {

  grams_a <- make_document_ngrams(doc_a, k = k)
  grams_b <- make_document_ngrams(doc_b, k = k)

  # 集合比较：相同片段只保留一次
  set_a <- unique(grams_a$gram)
  set_b <- unique(grams_b$gram)

  shared <- intersect(set_a, set_b)
  combined <- union(set_a, set_b)

  enough <- length(set_a) > 0L && length(set_b) > 0L

  similarity <- if (enough) {
    length(shared) / length(combined)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  list(
    similarity = similarity,
    status = if (enough) "ok" else "insufficient_ngrams",
    k = as.integer(k),
    unique_count_a = length(set_a),
    unique_count_b = length(set_b),
    shared_count = length(shared),
    union_count = length(combined)
  )
}

# 找到两份文档中内容完全相同的字符片段
match_text_ngrams <- function(
    doc_a, doc_b, k = 5L, max_pairs = 50000L) {

  if (!is.numeric(max_pairs) ||
      length(max_pairs) != 1L ||
      is.na(max_pairs) ||
      !is.finite(max_pairs) ||
      max_pairs < 1 ||
      max_pairs != floor(max_pairs)) {
    stop("max_pairs must be a positive integer.")
  }

  grams_a <- make_document_ngrams(doc_a, k = k)
  grams_b <- make_document_ngrams(doc_b, k = k)

  # 计算重复片段展开后，会产生多少对匹配
  counts_a <- table(grams_a$gram)
  counts_b <- table(grams_b$gram)

  shared <- intersect(names(counts_a), names(counts_b))

  pair_count <- sum(
    as.double(counts_a[shared]) *
      as.double(counts_b[shared])
  )

  # 防止大量重复片段产生过大的结果，不静默丢弃匹配
  if (pair_count > max_pairs) {
    stop(
      "Matching pairs exceed max_pairs. ",
      "Use a larger k or explicitly increase max_pairs."
    )
  }

  matches <- merge(
    grams_a,
    grams_b,
    by = "gram",
    suffixes = c("_a", "_b"),
    sort = FALSE
  )

  # 按两侧出现位置排序，方便检查
  matches <- matches[
    order(
      matches$unit_id_a,
      matches$normalized_start_a,
      matches$unit_id_b,
      matches$normalized_start_b
    ),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  rownames(matches) <- NULL

  matches
}
# END R/text.R

# BEGIN R/text-matches.R
# Exact normalized text matching. Load parser.R and text.R first.

empty_text_blocks <- function() {
  out <- data.frame(
    match_id = character(), file_id_a = character(), file_id_b = character(),
    unit_id_a = character(), unit_id_b = character(), text = character(),
    matched_chars = integer(), normalized_start_a = integer(),
    normalized_end_a = integer(), normalized_start_b = integer(),
    normalized_end_b = integer(), start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(),
    start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out$source_positions_a <- I(vector("list", 0L))
  out$source_positions_b <- I(vector("list", 0L))
  out
}

# Merge overlapping/adjacent seeds with the same unit pair and alignment shift.
merge_exact_text_matches <- function(
    doc_a, doc_b, k = 5L, min_chars = 30L, max_pairs = 50000L) {
  if (!is.numeric(min_chars) || length(min_chars) != 1L ||
      is.na(min_chars) || !is.finite(min_chars) || min_chars < 1 ||
      min_chars != floor(min_chars) || min_chars > .Machine$integer.max) {
    stop("min_chars must be a positive integer.")
  }
  hits <- match_text_ngrams(doc_a, doc_b, k = k, max_pairs = max_pairs)
  if (!nrow(hits)) return(empty_text_blocks())
  a <- prepare_text_units(doc_a); b <- prepare_text_units(doc_b)
  rows <- list()
  # which() handles a newline at position 1 correctly, including empty sources.
  line_starts <- function(text) {
    chars <- strsplit(text, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    c(1L, which(chars == "\n") + 1L)
  }
  lines_a <- line_starts(doc_a$source)
  lines_b <- line_starts(doc_b$source)

  emit <- function(ia, ib, sa, ea, sb, eb) {
    len <- ea - sa + 1L
    if (len < min_chars) return(invisible(NULL))
    ta <- substr(a$normalized_text[ia], sa, ea)
    tb <- substr(b$normalized_text[ib], sb, eb)
    if (!identical(ta, tb)) stop("Internal error: merged text does not agree.")
    pa <- a$source_positions[[ia]][seq.int(sa, ea)]
    pb <- b$source_positions[[ib]][seq.int(sb, eb)]
    row <- data.frame(
      match_id = "", file_id_a = doc_a$file_id, file_id_b = doc_b$file_id,
      unit_id_a = a$unit_id[ia], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[ib], text = ta,
      matched_chars = as.integer(len), normalized_start_a = as.integer(sa),
      normalized_end_a = as.integer(ea), normalized_start_b = as.integer(sb),
      normalized_end_b = as.integer(eb),
      start_line_a = as.integer(findInterval(pa[1L], lines_a)),
      end_line_a = as.integer(findInterval(tail(pa, 1L), lines_a)),
      start_line_b = as.integer(findInterval(pb[1L], lines_b)),
      end_line_b = as.integer(findInterval(tail(pb, 1L), lines_b)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    row$source_positions_a <- I(list(pa))
    row$source_positions_b <- I(list(pb))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <<- row
  }

  shift <- hits$normalized_start_b - hits$normalized_start_a
  keys <- paste(hits$unit_id_a, hits$unit_id_b, shift, sep = ":")
  groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(hits)), keys)
  for (indices in groups) {
    g <- hits[indices, , drop = FALSE]
    g <- g[order(g$normalized_start_a), , drop = FALSE]
    ia <- match(g$unit_id_a[1L], a$unit_id)
    ib <- match(g$unit_id_b[1L], b$unit_id)
    sa <- g$normalized_start_a[1L]; ea <- g$normalized_end_a[1L]
    sb <- g$normalized_start_b[1L]; eb <- g$normalized_end_b[1L]
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(g))[-1L]) {
      if (g$normalized_start_a[j] <= ea + 1L) {
        ea <- max(ea, g$normalized_end_a[j])
        eb <- max(eb, g$normalized_end_b[j])
      } else {
        emit(ia, ib, sa, ea, sb, eb)
        sa <- g$normalized_start_a[j]; ea <- g$normalized_end_a[j]
        sb <- g$normalized_start_b[j]; eb <- g$normalized_end_b[j]
      }
    }
    emit(ia, ib, sa, ea, sb, eb)
  }
  if (!length(rows)) return(empty_text_blocks())
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out <- out[order(-out$matched_chars, out$unit_id_a,
    out$normalized_start_a, out$unit_id_b, out$normalized_start_b), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out$match_id <- sprintf("m%05d", seq_len(nrow(out)))
  out
}

# Coverage uses actual source character sets, not lengths of bounding intervals.
summarize_text_coverage <- function(doc_a, doc_b, blocks) {
  if (!is.data.frame(blocks) ||
      !all(c("source_positions_a", "source_positions_b") %in% names(blocks))) {
    stop("blocks must be a text block table with both position columns.")
  }
  positions <- function(x) sort(unique(as.integer(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE))))
  valid_a <- positions(prepare_text_units(doc_a)$source_positions)
  valid_b <- positions(prepare_text_units(doc_b)$source_positions)
  matched_a <- positions(blocks$source_positions_a)
  matched_b <- positions(blocks$source_positions_b)
  if (!all(matched_a %in% valid_a) || !all(matched_b %in% valid_b)) {
    stop("Matched positions must belong to comparable text in each document.")
  }
  total <- c(length(valid_a), length(valid_b))
  covered <- c(length(matched_a), length(matched_b))
  ratio <- rep(NA_real_, 2L)
  ratio[total > 0L] <- covered[total > 0L] / total[total > 0L]
  data.frame(side = c("A", "B"), file_id = c(doc_a$file_id, doc_b$file_id),
    comparable_chars = total, matched_chars = covered, coverage = ratio,
    status = ifelse(total > 0L, "ok", "no_comparable_text"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# This is a text-only analysis, not a plagiarism verdict.
analyze_text_pair <- function(
    doc_a, doc_b, k = 5L, min_chars = 30L, max_pairs = 50000L) {
  jaccard <- compare_text_jaccard(doc_a, doc_b, k = k)
  blocks <- merge_exact_text_matches(doc_a, doc_b, k, min_chars, max_pairs)
  coverage <- summarize_text_coverage(doc_a, doc_b, blocks)
  has_warnings <- any(doc_a$diagnostics$severity == "warning") ||
    any(doc_b$diagnostics$severity == "warning")
  status <- if (jaccard$status != "ok") "insufficient_ngrams" else
    if (has_warnings) "limited" else "ok"
  list(status = status,
    parameters = list(k = as.integer(k), min_chars = as.integer(min_chars),
      max_pairs = max_pairs),
    jaccard = jaccard, exact_matches = blocks, coverage = coverage,
    diagnostics = list(a = doc_a$diagnostics, b = doc_b$diagnostics))
}
# END R/text-matches.R

# BEGIN R/text-approx.R
# Seed/window candidates and local alignment. Base R, no network or evaluation.
# Load parser.R, text.R and text-matches.R first.

.text_approximation_limit <- function(message) {
  stop(errorCondition(message, class = "text_approximation_limit"))
}

text_positive_integer <- function(x, name) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x) ||
      x < 1 || x != floor(x) || x > .Machine$integer.max)
    stop(name, " must be a positive integer.")
  as.integer(x)
}

make_text_windows <- function(doc, window_size = 200L, max_windows = 2000L) {
  size <- text_positive_integer(window_size, "window_size")
  limit <- text_positive_integer(max_windows, "max_windows")
  u <- prepare_text_units(doc)
  out <- data.frame(window_id = character(), unit_id = character(),
    start = integer(), end = integer(), text = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  out$source_positions <- I(vector("list", 0L))
  rows <- list(); step <- max(1L, size %/% 2L)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(u))) {
    n <- nchar(u$normalized_text[i], type = "chars")
    if (!n) next
    last <- max(1L, n - size + 1L)
    starts <- unique(c(seq.int(1L, last, by = step), last))
    if (length(rows) + length(starts) > limit)
      .text_approximation_limit("Window count exceeds max_windows; no partial result produced.")
    for (s in starts) {
      e <- min(n, s + size - 1L)
      row <- data.frame(window_id = sprintf("w%05d", length(rows) + 1L),
        unit_id = u$unit_id[i], start = as.integer(s), end = as.integer(e),
        text = substr(u$normalized_text[i], s, e), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      row$source_positions <- I(list(u$source_positions[[i]][seq.int(s, e)]))
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- row
    }
  }
  if (!length(rows)) return(out)
  result <- do.call(rbind, rows); rownames(result) <- NULL
  result
}

select_text_candidates <- function(windows_a, windows_b, seed_k = 3L,
    max_candidates = 500L, max_seed_pairs = 100000L) {
  k <- text_positive_integer(seed_k, "seed_k")
  limit <- text_positive_integer(max_candidates, "max_candidates")
  seed_limit <- text_positive_integer(max_seed_pairs, "max_seed_pairs")
  index <- function(w) {
    rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(w)), function(i) {
      g <- unique(make_character_ngrams(w$text[i], k)$gram)
      data.frame(gram = g, window = rep.int(i, length(g)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    })
    if (!length(rows)) return(data.frame(gram = character(), window = integer()))
    do.call(rbind, rows)
  }
  a <- index(windows_a); b <- index(windows_b)
  ca <- table(a$gram); cb <- table(b$gram)
  common <- intersect(names(ca), names(cb))
  seed_pairs <- sum(as.double(ca[common]) * as.double(cb[common]))
  if (seed_pairs > seed_limit)
    .text_approximation_limit("Shared-seed combinations exceed max_seed_pairs; no partial result produced.")
  if (!seed_pairs) return(data.frame(window_a = integer(), window_b = integer(), shared_seeds = integer()))
  hits <- merge(a, b, by = "gram", suffixes = c("_a", "_b"), sort = FALSE)
  pairs <- aggregate(rep.int(1L, nrow(hits)),
    by = list(window_a = hits$window_a, window_b = hits$window_b), FUN = sum)
  names(pairs)[3L] <- "shared_seeds"
  if (nrow(pairs) > limit)
    .text_approximation_limit("Candidate count exceeds max_candidates; no partial result produced.")
  pairs <- pairs[order(-pairs$shared_seeds, pairs$window_a, pairs$window_b), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(pairs) <- NULL
  pairs
}

# One best local alignment per pair. Fixed scores: equal +2, replace -1, gap -2.
# Equal-score ties prefer reset, diagonal, consume A, then consume B; earliest maximum wins.
align_text_local <- function(text_a, text_b, max_cells = 250000L) {
  validate <- function(x) {
    if (!is.character(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x))
      stop("Alignment inputs must be single non-missing strings.")
    strsplit(enc2utf8(x), "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  }
  a <- validate(text_a); b <- validate(text_b)
  limit <- text_positive_integer(max_cells, "max_cells")
  n <- length(a); m <- length(b)
  empty <- list(score = 0, similarity = NA_real_, equal_chars = 0L,
    columns = 0L, indices_a = integer(), indices_b = integer(),
    operations = character(), aligned_a = "", aligned_b = "")
  if (!n || !m) return(empty)
  if ((as.double(n) + 1) * (as.double(m) + 1) > limit)
    stop("Alignment matrix exceeds max_cells.")
  h <- matrix(0, n + 1L, m + 1L)
  trace <- matrix(0L, n + 1L, m + 1L)
  best <- 0; best_i <- 0L; best_j <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(n)) for (j in seq_len(m)) {
    values <- c(0, h[i, j] + if (a[i] == b[j]) 2 else -1,
      h[i, j + 1L] - 2, h[i + 1L, j] - 2)
    choice <- which.max(values)
    h[i + 1L, j + 1L] <- values[choice]
    trace[i + 1L, j + 1L] <- choice - 1L
    if (values[choice] > best) {
      best <- values[choice]; best_i <- i; best_j <- j
    }
  }
  if (!best) return(empty)
  i <- best_i; j <- best_j; ia <- integer(); ib <- integer(); ops <- character()
  while (i > 0L && j > 0L && h[i + 1L, j + 1L] > 0) {
    move <- trace[i + 1L, j + 1L]
    if (move == 1L) {
      ia <- c(ia, i); ib <- c(ib, j)
      ops <- c(ops, if (a[i] == b[j]) "equal" else "replace")
      i <- i - 1L; j <- j - 1L
    } else if (move == 2L) {
      ia <- c(ia, i); ib <- c(ib, NA_integer_); ops <- c(ops, "consume_a")
      i <- i - 1L
    } else if (move == 3L) {
      ia <- c(ia, NA_integer_); ib <- c(ib, j); ops <- c(ops, "consume_b")
      j <- j - 1L
    } else break
  }
  ia <- rev(ia); ib <- rev(ib); ops <- rev(ops)
  shown_a <- rep("-", length(ia)); shown_b <- rep("-", length(ib))
  shown_a[!is.na(ia)] <- a[ia[!is.na(ia)]]
  shown_b[!is.na(ib)] <- b[ib[!is.na(ib)]]
  list(score = best, similarity = sum(ops == "equal") / length(ops),
    equal_chars = as.integer(sum(ops == "equal")), columns = length(ops),
    indices_a = ia, indices_b = ib, operations = ops,
    aligned_a = paste0(shown_a, collapse = ""), aligned_b = paste0(shown_b, collapse = ""))
}

empty_approximate_matches <- function() {
  out <- data.frame(match_id = character(), unit_id_a = character(),
    unit_id_b = character(), text_a = character(), text_b = character(),
    aligned_a = character(), aligned_b = character(), equal_chars = integer(),
    alignment_columns = integer(), similarity = numeric(), score = numeric(),
    start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(), start_line_b = integer(),
    end_line_b = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (name in c("source_positions_a", "source_positions_b",
      "aligned_positions_a", "aligned_positions_b", "operations"))
    out[[name]] <- I(vector("list", 0L))
  out
}

find_approximate_text_matches <- function(doc_a, doc_b, seed_k = 3L,
    window_size = 200L, min_chars = 30L, min_similarity = 0.8,
    max_windows = 2000L, max_candidates = 500L, max_seed_pairs = 100000L,
    max_cells = 250000L, max_total_cells = 5000000L) {
  minimum <- text_positive_integer(min_chars, "min_chars")
  seed_k <- text_positive_integer(seed_k, "seed_k")
  cells_limit <- text_positive_integer(max_cells, "max_cells")
  total_limit <- text_positive_integer(max_total_cells, "max_total_cells")
  if (!is.numeric(min_similarity) || length(min_similarity) != 1L ||
      is.na(min_similarity) || !is.finite(min_similarity) ||
      min_similarity < 0 || min_similarity > 1)
    stop("min_similarity must be between 0 and 1.")
  wa <- make_text_windows(doc_a, window_size, max_windows)
  wb <- make_text_windows(doc_b, window_size, max_windows)
  candidates <- select_text_candidates(wa, wb, seed_k, max_candidates, max_seed_pairs)
  sizes <- (nchar(wa$text[candidates$window_a]) + 1) *
    (nchar(wb$text[candidates$window_b]) + 1)
  if (any(sizes > cells_limit) || sum(sizes) > total_limit)
    .text_approximation_limit("Alignment work exceeds max_cells or max_total_cells; no partial result produced.")
  lines <- function(text) c(1L, which(strsplit(text, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]] == "\n") + 1L)
  la <- lines(doc_a$source); lb <- lines(doc_b$source); rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {
    a <- wa[candidates$window_a[i], , drop = FALSE]
    b <- wb[candidates$window_b[i], , drop = FALSE]
    aligned <- align_text_local(a$text, b$text, max_cells = cells_limit)
    if (aligned$equal_chars < minimum || is.na(aligned$similarity) ||
        aligned$similarity < min_similarity) next
    pa <- a$source_positions[[1L]][aligned$indices_a]
    pb <- b$source_positions[[1L]][aligned$indices_b]
    equal <- aligned$operations == "equal"
    used_a <- aligned$indices_a[!is.na(aligned$indices_a)]
    used_b <- aligned$indices_b[!is.na(aligned$indices_b)]
    row <- data.frame(match_id = "", unit_id_a = a$unit_id,
      unit_id_b = b$unit_id, text_a = substr(a$text, min(used_a), max(used_a)),
      text_b = substr(b$text, min(used_b), max(used_b)),
      aligned_a = aligned$aligned_a, aligned_b = aligned$aligned_b,
      equal_chars = aligned$equal_chars, alignment_columns = aligned$columns,
      similarity = aligned$similarity, score = aligned$score,
      start_line_a = as.integer(findInterval(min(pa, na.rm = TRUE), la)),
      end_line_a = as.integer(findInterval(max(pa, na.rm = TRUE), la)),
      start_line_b = as.integer(findInterval(min(pb, na.rm = TRUE), lb)),
      end_line_b = as.integer(findInterval(max(pb, na.rm = TRUE), lb)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    # Only truly equal aligned characters contribute to the coverage numerator.
    row$source_positions_a <- I(list(pa[equal]))
    row$source_positions_b <- I(list(pb[equal]))
    row$aligned_positions_a <- I(list(pa))
    row$aligned_positions_b <- I(list(pb))
    row$operations <- I(list(aligned$operations))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- row
  }
  out <- if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows) else empty_approximate_matches()
  if (nrow(out)) {
    keys <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(out)), function(i) paste(out$unit_id_a[i],
      out$unit_id_b[i], paste(out$source_positions_a[[i]], collapse = ","),
      paste(out$source_positions_b[[i]], collapse = ","), sep = ":"), character(1))
    ord <- order(-out$similarity, -out$equal_chars, -out$score)
    out <- out[ord, , drop = FALSE]; keys <- keys[ord]
    out <- out[!duplicated(keys), , drop = FALSE]
    out$match_id <- sprintf("a%05d", seq_len(nrow(out))); rownames(out) <- NULL
  }
  enough <- any(nchar(wa$text) >= seed_k) && any(nchar(wb$text) >= seed_k)
  list(status = if (enough) "ok" else "insufficient_ngrams", matches = out,
    candidates = candidates, windows_a = nrow(wa), windows_b = nrow(wb),
    alignment_cells = sum(sizes))
}

find_short_text_matches <- function(doc_a, doc_b, min_chars, max_pairs = 10000L) {
  # Use complete units and require a unique counterpart on both sides.
  units_a <- prepare_text_units(doc_a); units_b <- prepare_text_units(doc_b)
  repeated <- c(units_a$normalized_text[duplicated(units_a$normalized_text)],
    units_b$normalized_text[duplicated(units_b$normalized_text)])
  short_units <- function(units) {
    x <- units$normalized_text
    keep <- nchar(x) >= 8L & nchar(x) <= min(min_chars + 4, 60L) &
      grepl("[[:alnum:]]", x) & !x %in% repeated
    units[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  a <- short_units(units_a); b <- short_units(units_b)
  x <- a$normalized_text; y <- b$normalized_text
  na <- nchar(x); nb <- nchar(y)
  exact <- match(x, y)
  ia <- which(!is.na(exact) & na < min_chars)
  ib <- exact[ia]
  xa <- which(is.na(exact) & na >= 12L)
  yb <- which(!y %in% x & nb >= 12L)
  limited <- as.double(length(xa)) * length(yb) > max_pairs
  if (!limited && length(xa) && length(yb)) {
    distance <- utils::adist(x[xa], y[yb])
    lengths <- outer(na[xa], nb[yb], pmax)
    short_enough <- outer(na[xa], nb[yb], pmin) < min_chars
    candidates <- short_enough & distance <= pmax(1L, floor(.15 * lengths))
    pair <- which(candidates & rowSums(candidates) == 1L &
      rep(colSums(candidates) == 1L, each = nrow(candidates)), arr.ind = TRUE)
    ia <- c(ia, xa[pair[, 1L]]); ib <- c(ib, yb[pair[, 2L]])
  }
  matches <- data.frame(start_line_a = a$start_line[ia], end_line_a = a$end_line[ia],
    start_line_b = b$start_line[ib], end_line_b = b$end_line[ib],
    equal_chars = integer(length(ia)), similarity = numeric(length(ia)),
    text_a = a$content[ia], text_b = b$content[ib])
  positions_a <- positions_b <- vector("list", length(ia))
  for (i in seq_along(ia)) {
    j <- ia[i]; k <- ib[i]
    transform <- if (x[j] == y[k]) strrep("M", na[j]) else
      attr(utils::adist(x[j], y[k], counts = TRUE), "trafos")[1L, 1L]
    operations <- strsplit(transform, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    equal <- operations == "M"
    positions_a[[i]] <- a$source_positions[[j]][cumsum(operations != "I")[equal]]
    positions_b[[i]] <- b$source_positions[[k]][cumsum(operations != "D")[equal]]
    matches$equal_chars[i] <- sum(equal)
    matches$similarity[i] <- sum(equal) / length(operations)
  }
  matches$source_positions_a <- I(positions_a)
  matches$source_positions_b <- I(positions_b)
  list(matches = matches, limited = limited)
}

analyze_text_pair_approx <- function(doc_a, doc_b, k = 5L, min_chars = 30L,
    min_similarity = 0.8, seed_k = 3L, window_size = 200L,
    max_pairs = 50000L, max_windows = 2000L, max_candidates = 500L,
    max_seed_pairs = 100000L, max_cells = 250000L, max_total_cells = 5000000L) {
  exact <- analyze_text_pair(doc_a, doc_b, k, min_chars, max_pairs)
  approximate <- tryCatch(
    find_approximate_text_matches(doc_a, doc_b, seed_k, window_size,
      min_chars, min_similarity, max_windows, max_candidates, max_seed_pairs,
      max_cells, max_total_cells),
    text_approximation_limit = function(e) list(status = "resource_limit",
      error = conditionMessage(e), matches = empty_approximate_matches(), alignment_cells = NA_real_))
  limited <- approximate$status == "resource_limit"
  columns <- c("source_positions_a", "source_positions_b")
  combined <- rbind(exact$exact_matches[, columns, drop = FALSE],
    approximate$matches[, columns, drop = FALSE])
  short <- if (!limited) find_short_text_matches(doc_a, doc_b, min_chars)
  coverage <- summarize_text_coverage(doc_a, doc_b, combined)
  warnings <- any(doc_a$diagnostics$severity == "warning") ||
    any(doc_b$diagnostics$severity == "warning")
  enough <- exact$jaccard$status == "ok" || approximate$status == "ok"
  list(status = if (limited) "limited" else if (!enough) "insufficient_ngrams" else if (warnings) "limited" else "ok",
    parameters = list(k = k, min_chars = min_chars, min_similarity = min_similarity,
      seed_k = seed_k, window_size = window_size, max_pairs = max_pairs,
      max_windows = max_windows, max_candidates = max_candidates,
      max_seed_pairs = max_seed_pairs, max_cells = max_cells, max_total_cells = max_total_cells),
    jaccard = exact$jaccard, exact_matches = exact$exact_matches,
    approximate_matches = approximate$matches, exact_coverage = exact$coverage,
    approximate_status = approximate$status, approximate_error = if (limited) approximate$error else "",
    coverage = coverage, short_matches = short$matches, short_matching_limited = isTRUE(short$limited),
    coverage_with_short = if (is.null(short) || !nrow(short$matches)) coverage else
      summarize_text_coverage(doc_a, doc_b, rbind(combined, short$matches[, columns])),
    candidate_count = if (limited) NA_integer_ else nrow(approximate$candidates),
    alignment_cells = approximate$alignment_cells,
    diagnostics = exact$diagnostics)
}
# END R/text-approx.R

# BEGIN R/math.R
# Formula comparison foundation. Never evaluate TeX, R or symbolic expressions.
math_one_string <- function(x) {
  if (!is.character(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x))
    stop("formula must be one non-missing character string.")
}

normalize_math <- function(formula) {
  math_one_string(formula)
  chars <- strsplit(enc2utf8(formula), "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  n <- length(chars)
  if (n > 20000L) stop("Formula character limit exceeded (20000).")
  tokens <- character(); kinds <- character(); positions <- list()
  issues <- character(); depth <- 0L
  add <- function(value, kind, ids) {
    tokens <<- c(tokens, value); kinds <<- c(kinds, kind)
    positions[[length(positions) + 1L]] <<- as.integer(ids)
  }
  greek <- c("alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta", "epsilon", "varepsilon",
    "zeta", "eta", "theta", "vartheta", "iota", "kappa", "lambda", "mu",
    "nu", "xi", "pi", "varpi", "rho", "varrho", "sigma", "varsigma",
    "tau", "upsilon", "phi", "varphi", "chi", "psi", "omega",
    "Gamma", "Delta", "Theta", "Lambda", "Xi", "Pi", "Sigma", "Upsilon", "Phi", "Psi", "Omega")
  layout <- c("left", "right", "big", "Big", "bigg", "Bigg", "bigl", "bigr",
    "Bigl", "Bigr", "biggl", "biggr", "Biggl", "Biggr", "quad", "qquad", "enspace", "thinspace")
  fixed <- c("frac", "sqrt", "sum", "prod", "int", "iint", "lim", "sin", "cos", "tan",
    "log", "ln", "exp", "min", "max", "sup", "inf", "det", "Pr", "bar", "hat",
    "widehat", "tilde", "widetilde", "overline", "underline", "vec", "dot", "ddot",
    "le", "leq", "ge", "geq", "ne", "neq", "approx", "sim", "equiv", "in", "notin",
    "subset", "subseteq", "cup", "cap", "cdot", "times", "div", "pm", "mp", "infty",
    "partial", "nabla", "forall", "exists", "to", "rightarrow", "Rightarrow", "langle",
    "rangle", "lvert", "rvert", "vert", "Vert", "ldots", "cdots", "dots")
  literal <- c("text", "mathrm", "mathbf", "mathit", "mathsf", "mathtt", "mathcal", "mathbb", "operatorname")
  p <- 1L
  while (p <= n) {
    ch <- chars[p]
    if (ch %in% c(" ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v")) { p <- p + 1L; next }
    if (ch == "\\") {
      start <- p; p <- p + 1L
      if (p > n) { issues <- c(issues, "trailing_backslash"); add("\\", "fixed", start); next }
      if (grepl("^[A-Za-z]$", chars[p])) {
        j <- p
        while (p <= n && grepl("^[A-Za-z]$", chars[p])) p <- p + 1L
        name <- paste0(chars[seq.int(j, p - 1L)], collapse = "")
        if (name %in% layout) next
        if (name %in% c("dfrac", "tfrac")) name <- "frac"
        if (name %in% literal) {
          # Preserve text/font payload literally, including words and spaces.
          q <- p
          while (q <= n && chars[q] %in% c(" ", "\t", "\n", "\r")) q <- q + 1L
          if (q <= n && chars[q] == "{") {
            level <- 1L; j <- q + 1L
            while (j <= n && level > 0L) {
              if (chars[j] == "\\" && j < n) { j <- j + 2L; next }
              if (chars[j] == "{") level <- level + 1L
              if (chars[j] == "}") level <- level - 1L
              j <- j + 1L
            }
            if (level == 0L) {
              add(paste0("\\", name), "fixed", seq.int(start, p - 1L))
              add(paste0(chars[seq.int(q, j - 1L)], collapse = ""), "literal", seq.int(q, j - 1L))
              p <- j; next
            }
          }
          issues <- c(issues, "invalid_literal_group")
        } else if (!name %in% c(greek, fixed)) {
          issues <- c(issues, paste0("unsupported_command:", name))
        }
        add(paste0("\\", name), if (name %in% greek) "variable" else "fixed", seq.int(start, p - 1L))
      } else {
        symbol <- chars[p]; p <- p + 1L
        if (symbol %in% c(",", ";", ":", "!", " ")) next
        if (!symbol %in% c("{", "}", "_", "%", "#", "&", "$", "|"))
          issues <- c(issues, paste0("unsupported_control_symbol:", symbol))
        add(paste0("\\", symbol), "fixed", seq.int(start, p - 1L))
      }
      next
    }
    if (ch == "{") depth <- depth + 1L
    if (ch == "}") {
      depth <- depth - 1L
      if (depth < 0L) issues <- c(issues, "unbalanced_braces")
    }
    if (ch %in% c("%", "#", "&", "$")) issues <- c(issues, "unsupported_tex_syntax")
    if (!grepl("^[ -~]$", ch)) issues <- c(issues, "unsupported_non_ascii_symbol")
    add(ch, if (grepl("^[A-Za-z]$", ch)) "variable" else "fixed", p)
    p <- p + 1L
  }
  if (depth != 0L) issues <- c(issues, "unbalanced_braces")
  # Token keys use lengths: concatenation alone could merge distinct commands.
  key <- function(x) paste0(nchar(x, type = "chars"), ":", x, collapse = "|")
  vars <- unique(tokens[kinds == "variable"])
  structural <- tokens
  selected <- kinds == "variable"
  structural[selected] <- paste0("@v", match(tokens[selected], vars))
  issues <- unique(issues)
  list(raw = formula, normalized = paste0(tokens, collapse = ""), tokens = tokens,
    kinds = kinds, source_positions = positions, normalized_key = key(tokens),
    structure_key = if (!length(issues) && length(tokens)) key(structural) else NA_character_,
    variables = vars, token_count = length(tokens), issues = issues,
    status = if (length(issues)) "limited" else if (!length(tokens)) "empty" else "ok")
}

prepare_math_units <- function(doc) {
  if (!inherits(doc, "rmd_document")) stop("doc must be an rmd_document.")
  units <- doc$units[doc$units$type == "math", , drop = FALSE]
  parsed <- lapply(units$content, normalize_math)
  for (i in seq_along(parsed)) {
    parsed[[i]]$source_positions <- lapply(parsed[[i]]$source_positions,
      function(p) as.integer(units$content_start[i] + p - 1L))
    if (units$status[i] != "ok") {
      parsed[[i]]$status <- "limited"
      parsed[[i]]$issues <- unique(c(parsed[[i]]$issues, "parser_limited"))
      parsed[[i]]$structure_key <- NA_character_
    }
  }
  units$normalized <- vapply(parsed, function(x) x$normalized, character(1))
  units$math_status <- vapply(parsed, function(x) x$status, character(1))
  units$token_count <- vapply(parsed, function(x) as.integer(x$token_count), integer(1))
  units$details <- I(parsed)
  units
}

compare_math_pair <- function(doc_a, doc_b, max_pairs = 10000L) {
  if (!is.numeric(max_pairs) || length(max_pairs) != 1L || is.na(max_pairs) ||
      !is.finite(max_pairs) || max_pairs < 1 || max_pairs != floor(max_pairs))
    stop("max_pairs must be a positive integer.")
  a <- prepare_math_units(doc_a); b <- prepare_math_units(doc_b)
  pair_count <- as.double(nrow(a)) * nrow(b)
  if (pair_count > max_pairs) stop("Formula pair limit exceeded.")
  matches <- data.frame(file_id_a = character(), file_id_b = character(),
    unit_id_a = character(), unit_id_b = character(),
    raw_equal = logical(), normalized_equal = logical(), renamed_equal = logical(),
    token_count = integer(), start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(),
    start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(),
    status = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  matches$variable_map <- I(list())
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(a))) for (j in seq_len(nrow(b))) {
    x <- a$details[[i]]; y <- b$details[[j]]
    supported <- x$status == "ok" && y$status == "ok"
    raw <- x$token_count > 0L && identical(x$raw, y$raw)
    normalized <- supported && identical(x$normalized_key, y$normalized_key)
    renamed <- supported && identical(x$structure_key, y$structure_key)
    if (!raw && !normalized && !renamed) next
    row <- data.frame(file_id_a = a$file_id[i], file_id_b = b$file_id[j],
      unit_id_a = a$unit_id[i], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[j],
      raw_equal = raw, normalized_equal = normalized, renamed_equal = renamed,
      token_count = as.integer(min(x$token_count, y$token_count)),
      start_line_a = a$start_line[i], end_line_a = a$end_line[i],
      start_line_b = b$start_line[j], end_line_b = b$end_line[j],
      status = if (supported) "ok" else "limited", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    row$variable_map <- I(list(if (renamed) data.frame(a = x$variables, b = y$variables,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE) else data.frame(a = character(), b = character())))
    matches <- rbind(matches, row)
  }
  has_math_a <- nrow(a) > 0L; has_math_b <- nrow(b) > 0L
  limited <- any(c(a$math_status, b$math_status) == "limited") ||
    any(c(doc_a$diagnostics$severity, doc_b$diagnostics$severity) %in% c("warning", "error"))
  status <- if (limited) "limited" else if (!has_math_a || !has_math_b) "not_applicable" else
    if (any(c(a$math_status, b$math_status) == "empty")) "insufficient_content" else "ok"
  list(status = status, formulas_a = a, formulas_b = b, matches = matches,
    pair_count = pair_count, max_pairs = max_pairs,
    diagnostics = list(a = doc_a$diagnostics, b = doc_b$diagnostics))
}

# Return source-indexed rows. Unsupported structures remain a single barrier.
.math_step_plan <- function(unit) {
  chars <- strsplit(unit$content, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  n <- length(chars)
  if (n > 20000L) stop("Formula character limit exceeded (20000).")
  cut <- function(a, b) if (a > b) "" else paste0(chars[seq.int(a, b)], collapse = "")
  ws <- c(" ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v")
  escaped <- function(at) {
    j <- at - 1L; count <- 0L
    while (j >= 1L && chars[j] == "\\") { count <- count + 1L; j <- j - 1L }
    count %% 2L == 1L
  }
  trim <- function(a, b) {
    while (a <= b && chars[a] %in% ws) a <- a + 1L
    while (b >= a && chars[b] %in% ws && !escaped(b)) b <- b - 1L
    c(a, b)
  }
  mode <- ""; issues <- character()
  fallback <- function(issue) list(environment = mode,
    rows = list(list(start = 1L, end = n, drop = integer())), issues = issue)
  supported <- c("align", "align*", "aligned", "gather", "gather*", "gathered", "equation", "equation*")
  opening <- regmatches(unit$raw, regexpr("^\\\\begin\\{[A-Za-z*]+\\}", unit$raw))
  if (length(opening) && nzchar(opening)) {
    mode <- sub("^\\\\begin\\{([^}]+)\\}$", "\\1", opening)
    if (!mode %in% supported) return(fallback("unsupported_step_environment"))
  }
  bounds <- trim(1L, n); lo <- bounds[1L]; hi <- bounds[2L]
  # Permit a single row environment inside an equation wrapper, or one display wrapper.
  repeat {
    body <- cut(lo, hi)
    opener <- regmatches(body, regexpr("^\\\\begin\\{[A-Za-z*]+\\}", body))
    if (!length(opener) || !nzchar(opener)) break
    name <- sub("^\\\\begin\\{([^}]+)\\}$", "\\1", opener)
    if (!name %in% supported || (nzchar(mode) &&
        !(mode %in% c("equation", "equation*") && name %in% c("aligned", "gathered"))))
      return(fallback("unsupported_nested_environment"))
    closer <- paste0("\\end{", name, "}")
    if (!endsWith(body, closer) || nchar(body) < nchar(opener) + nchar(closer))
      return(fallback("unclosed_step_environment"))
    mode <- name
    bounds <- trim(lo + nchar(opener), hi - nchar(closer))
    lo <- bounds[1L]; hi <- bounds[2L]
  }
  row_mode <- mode %in% c("align", "align*", "aligned", "gather", "gather*", "gathered")
  align_mode <- mode %in% c("align", "align*", "aligned")
  rows <- list(); start <- lo; dropped <- integer(); ampersands <- 0L; depth <- 0L; p <- lo
  emit <- function(end) {
    bounds <- trim(start, end)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <<- list(start = bounds[1L], end = bounds[2L], drop = dropped)
    if (ampersands > 1L) issues <<- c(issues, "multiple_alignment_columns")
  }
  while (p <= hi) {
    ch <- chars[p]
    if (ch == "\\") {
      if (p < hi && chars[p + 1L] == "\\") {
        if (depth == 0L) {
          if (!row_mode) return(fallback("row_break_outside_supported_environment"))
          emit(p - 1L)
          p <- p + 2L
          if (p <= hi && chars[p] == "*") p <- p + 1L
          if (p <= hi && chars[p] == "[") {
            q <- p + 1L
            while (q <= hi && chars[q] != "]") q <- q + 1L
            spacing <- trimws(cut(p + 1L, q - 1L))
            if (q > hi || !grepl("^[+-]?([0-9]+(\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(pt|pc|bp|dd|cc|sp|mm|cm|in|em|ex)$", spacing))
              return(fallback("unsupported_row_spacing"))
            p <- q + 1L
          }
          start <- p; dropped <- integer(); ampersands <- 0L
          next
        }
        p <- p + 2L; next
      }
      q <- p + 1L
      while (q <= hi && grepl("^[A-Za-z]$", chars[q])) q <- q + 1L
      command <- cut(p + 1L, q - 1L)
      if (command %in% c("begin", "end")) return(fallback("unsupported_nested_environment"))
      if (depth == 0L && command %in% c("notag", "nonumber"))
        dropped <- c(dropped, seq.int(p, q - 1L))
      p <- if (q == p + 1L) min(p + 2L, hi + 1L) else q
      next
    }
    if (ch == "{") depth <- depth + 1L
    if (ch == "}") depth <- depth - 1L
    if (depth < 0L) return(fallback("unbalanced_step_braces"))
    if (ch == "&" && depth == 0L) {
      if (!align_mode) return(fallback("alignment_outside_supported_environment"))
      ampersands <- ampersands + 1L; dropped <- c(dropped, p)
    }
    p <- p + 1L
  }
  if (depth != 0L) return(fallback("unbalanced_step_braces"))
  last <- trim(start, hi)
  # A trailing row break is allowed; empty internal rows are retained as barriers.
  if (last[1L] <= last[2L] || !length(rows)) emit(hi)
  if (any(vapply(rows, function(r) r$start > r$end, logical(1))) && length(rows) > 1L)
    issues <- c(issues, "empty_internal_math_row")
  list(environment = mode, rows = rows, issues = unique(issues))
}

prepare_math_steps <- function(doc, max_steps = 500L) {
  if (!inherits(doc, "rmd_document")) stop("doc must be an rmd_document.")
  if (!is.numeric(max_steps) || length(max_steps) != 1L || is.na(max_steps) ||
      !is.finite(max_steps) || max_steps < 1 || max_steps != floor(max_steps) || max_steps > .Machine$integer.max)
    stop("max_steps must be a representable positive integer.")
  units <- doc$units[doc$units$type == "math", , drop = FALSE]
  result <- units[FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
  for (name in c("parent_unit_id", "parent_raw", "environment", "comparison_content", "normalized", "math_status"))
    result[[name]] <- character()
  result$step_index <- integer(); result$token_count <- integer()
  result$comparison_positions <- I(list()); result$details <- I(list())
  source_chars <- strsplit(doc$source, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  line_starts <- c(1L, which(source_chars == "\n") + 1L)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(units))) {
    parent <- units[i, , drop = FALSE]
    chars <- strsplit(parent$content, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    plan <- .math_step_plan(parent)
    if (nrow(result) + length(plan$rows) > max_steps) stop("Expanded formula step limit exceeded.")
    rows <- lapply(seq_along(plan$rows), function(j) {
      span <- plan$rows[[j]]
      ids <- if (span$start <= span$end) seq.int(span$start, span$end) else integer()
      keep <- ids[!ids %in% span$drop]
      raw <- paste0(chars[ids], collapse = "")
      comparison <- paste0(chars[keep], collapse = "")
      positions <- as.integer(parent$content_start + keep - 1L)
      details <- normalize_math(comparison)
      details$source_positions <- lapply(details$source_positions, function(p) positions[p])
      details$comparison_content <- comparison; details$raw <- raw
      row <- parent
      row$parent_unit_id <- parent$unit_id; row$parent_raw <- parent$raw
      row$environment <- plan$environment; row$step_index <- as.integer(j)
      if (nzchar(plan$environment) || length(plan$rows) > 1L)
        row$unit_id <- paste0(parent$unit_id, ":s", sprintf("%03d", j))
      row$content_start <- as.integer(parent$content_start + span$start - 1L)
      row$content_end <- as.integer(parent$content_start + span$end - 1L)
      row$start_offset <- row$content_start; row$end_offset <- row$content_end
      row$start_line <- as.integer(findInterval(row$start_offset, line_starts))
      row$end_line <- as.integer(findInterval(max(row$start_offset, row$end_offset), line_starts))
      row$start_column <- as.integer(row$start_offset - line_starts[row$start_line] + 1L)
      row$end_column <- as.integer(row$end_offset - line_starts[row$end_line] + 1L)
      row$raw <- raw; row$content <- raw; row$comparison_content <- comparison
      row$normalized <- details$normalized; row$math_status <- details$status
      row$token_count <- as.integer(details$token_count)
      row$comparison_positions <- I(list(positions)); row$details <- I(list(details))
      row[, names(result), drop = FALSE]
    })
    issues <- unique(c(plan$issues, if (parent$status != "ok") "parser_limited",
      unlist(lapply(rows, function(r) r$details[[1L]]$issues), use.names = FALSE)))
    if (length(rows) > 1L && any(vapply(rows, function(r) r$math_status == "empty", logical(1))))
      issues <- unique(c(issues, "empty_internal_math_row"))
    # Any unsupported row limits the whole parent; do not silently salvage it.
    if (length(issues)) rows <- lapply(rows, function(row) {
      row$math_status <- "limited"; row$details[[1L]]$status <- "limited"
      row$details[[1L]]$issues <- issues; row$details[[1L]]$structure_key <- NA_character_
      row
    })
    for (row in rows) result <- rbind(result, row)
  }
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  result
}
# END R/math.R

# BEGIN R/math-sequences.R
# Requires parser.R and math.R. Steps include supported multiline rows.
math_sequence_integer <- function(x, name, zero = FALSE) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x) ||
      x != floor(x) || x < (if (zero) 0 else 1) || x > .Machine$integer.max)
    stop(paste(name, "must be a representable", if (zero) "nonnegative" else "positive", "integer."))
  as.integer(x)
}

.extend_math_mapping <- function(x, y, mapping) {
  if (x$status != "ok" || y$status != "ok" ||
      !identical(x$structure_key, y$structure_key)) return(NULL)
  for (k in seq_along(x$tokens)) {
    if (x$kinds[k] != "variable") next
    a <- x$tokens[k]; b <- y$tokens[k]
    existing <- match(a, mapping$a)
    if (!is.na(existing)) {
      if (mapping$b[existing] != b) return(NULL)
    } else {
      if (b %in% mapping$b) return(NULL)
      mapping <- rbind(mapping, data.frame(a = a, b = b, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  mapping
}

.math_sequence_links <- function(doc, units, max_source_gap) {
  n <- nrow(units)
  if (n < 2L) return(logical())
  vapply(seq_len(n - 1L), function(i) {
    between <- doc$units$start_offset > units$end_offset[i] &
      doc$units$end_offset < units$start_offset[i + 1L]
    blocked <- any(doc$units$type[between] %in% c("heading", "code", "inline_r", "inline_code")) ||
      any(doc$units$status[between] != "ok")
    units$math_status[i] == "ok" && units$math_status[i + 1L] == "ok" &&
      identical(units$section[i], units$section[i + 1L]) && !blocked &&
      units$start_offset[i + 1L] - units$end_offset[i] - 1L <= max_source_gap
  }, logical(1))
}

find_math_sequences <- function(doc_a, doc_b, min_steps = 2L, max_steps = 5L,
    max_skips = 1L, max_source_gap = 2000L, max_pairs = 10000L,
    max_states = 20000L, max_results = 1000L, max_token_work = 5000000L,
    max_formulas = 500L) {
  min_steps <- math_sequence_integer(min_steps, "min_steps")
  max_steps <- math_sequence_integer(max_steps, "max_steps")
  max_skips <- math_sequence_integer(max_skips, "max_skips", TRUE)
  max_source_gap <- math_sequence_integer(max_source_gap, "max_source_gap", TRUE)
  max_pairs <- math_sequence_integer(max_pairs, "max_pairs")
  max_states <- math_sequence_integer(max_states, "max_states")
  max_results <- math_sequence_integer(max_results, "max_results")
  max_token_work <- math_sequence_integer(max_token_work, "max_token_work")
  max_formulas <- math_sequence_integer(max_formulas, "max_formulas")
  if (min_steps < 2L || min_steps > max_steps || max_steps > 20L)
    stop("Require 2 <= min_steps <= max_steps <= 20.")
  if (!inherits(doc_a, "rmd_document") || !inherits(doc_b, "rmd_document"))
    stop("Both inputs must be rmd_document objects.")
  na <- sum(doc_a$units$type == "math"); nb <- sum(doc_b$units$type == "math")
  if (max(na, nb) > max_formulas) stop("Formula unit limit exceeded.")
  if (as.double(na) * nb > max_pairs) stop("Formula pair limit exceeded.")
  a <- prepare_math_steps(doc_a, max_steps = max_formulas)
  b <- prepare_math_steps(doc_b, max_steps = max_formulas)
  na <- nrow(a); nb <- nrow(b)
  if (as.double(na) * nb > max_pairs) stop("Expanded formula pair limit exceeded.")
  links_a <- .math_sequence_links(doc_a, a, max_source_gap)
  links_b <- .math_sequence_links(doc_b, b, max_source_gap)
  states <- 0; token_work <- 0; paths <- list()
  attempt <- function(i, j, mapping) {
    states <<- states + 1
    token_work <<- token_work + max(a$token_count[i], b$token_count[j])
    if (states > max_states) stop("Formula search state limit exceeded.")
    if (token_work > max_token_work) stop("Formula token work limit exceeded.")
    .extend_math_mapping(a$details[[i]], b$details[[j]], mapping)
  }
  walk <- function(ia, ib, mapping, skipped) {
    i <- tail(ia, 1L); j <- tail(ib, 1L)
    extended <- FALSE
    if (length(ia) < max_steps && i < na && j < nb) {
      remaining <- max_skips - skipped
      for (di in seq_len(min(as.double(remaining) + 1, na - i))) {
        if (!all(links_a[seq.int(i, i + di - 1L)])) next
        for (dj in seq_len(min(as.double(remaining) - di + 2, nb - j))) {
          if (!all(links_b[seq.int(j, j + dj - 1L)])) next
          next_map <- attempt(i + di, j + dj, mapping)
          if (is.null(next_map)) next
          extended <- TRUE
          walk(c(ia, i + di), c(ib, j + dj), next_map, skipped + di + dj - 2L)
        }
      }
    }
    if (!extended && length(ia) >= min_steps) {
      if (length(paths) >= max_results) stop("Formula result limit exceeded.")
      paths[[length(paths) + 1L]] <<- list(a = ia, b = ib, mapping = mapping,
        skipped = skipped, keys = paste(ia, ib, sep = ":"))
    }
  }
  empty_map <- data.frame(a = character(), b = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (i in seq_len(na)) for (j in seq_len(nb)) {
    mapping <- attempt(i, j, empty_map)
    if (!is.null(mapping)) walk(i, j, mapping, 0L)
  }
  # Remove contained paths, preserving distinct positional alignments.
  keep <- vapply(seq_along(paths), function(i) {
    !any(vapply(seq_along(paths), function(j) length(paths[[j]]$a) > length(paths[[i]]$a) &&
      all(paths[[i]]$keys %in% paths[[j]]$keys), logical(1)))
  }, logical(1))
  paths <- paths[keep]
  matches <- data.frame(file_id_a = character(), file_id_b = character(),
    matched_steps = integer(), skipped_steps = integer(), step_similarity = numeric(),
    token_count = integer(), raw_equal = logical(), normalized_equal = logical(),
    start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(), start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (name in c("step_pairs", "variable_map", "skipped_units_a", "skipped_units_b")) matches[[name]] <- I(list())
  for (path in paths) {
    ia <- path$a; ib <- path$b
    pairs <- data.frame(unit_id_a = a$unit_id[ia], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[ib],
      parent_unit_id_a = a$parent_unit_id[ia], parent_unit_id_b = b$parent_unit_id[ib],
      step_index_a = a$step_index[ia], step_index_b = b$step_index[ib],
      content_a = a$content[ia], content_b = b$content[ib],
      start_line_a = a$start_line[ia], end_line_a = a$end_line[ia],
      start_line_b = b$start_line[ib], end_line_b = b$end_line[ib], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    pairs$token_positions_a <- I(lapply(a$details[ia], function(x) x$source_positions))
    pairs$token_positions_b <- I(lapply(b$details[ib], function(x) x$source_positions))
    raw <- all(vapply(seq_along(ia), function(k) identical(a$content[ia[k]], b$content[ib[k]]), logical(1)))
    normalized <- all(vapply(seq_along(ia), function(k)
      identical(a$details[[ia[k]]]$normalized_key, b$details[[ib[k]]]$normalized_key), logical(1)))
    row <- data.frame(file_id_a = doc_a$file_id, file_id_b = doc_b$file_id,
      matched_steps = length(ia), skipped_steps = path$skipped,
      step_similarity = length(ia) / (length(ia) + path$skipped),
      token_count = as.integer(sum(a$token_count[ia])), raw_equal = raw, normalized_equal = normalized,
      start_line_a = a$start_line[ia[1L]], end_line_a = a$end_line[tail(ia, 1L)],
      start_line_b = b$start_line[ib[1L]], end_line_b = b$end_line[tail(ib, 1L)], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    row$step_pairs <- I(list(pairs)); row$variable_map <- I(list(path$mapping))
    row$skipped_units_a <- I(list(a$unit_id[setdiff(seq.int(ia[1L], tail(ia, 1L)), ia)]))
    row$skipped_units_b <- I(list(b$unit_id[setdiff(seq.int(ib[1L], tail(ib, 1L)), ib)]))
    matches <- rbind(matches, row)
  }
  if (nrow(matches)) {
    matches <- matches[order(-matches$matched_steps, matches$skipped_steps,
      matches$start_line_a, matches$start_line_b), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(matches) <- NULL
  }
  limited <- any(c(a$math_status, b$math_status) == "limited") ||
    any(c(doc_a$diagnostics$severity, doc_b$diagnostics$severity) %in% c("warning", "error"))
  status <- if (limited) "limited" else if (!na || !nb) "not_applicable" else
    if (min(sum(a$math_status == "ok"), sum(b$math_status == "ok")) < min_steps)
      "insufficient_steps" else "ok"
  list(status = status, matches = matches, formulas_a = a, formulas_b = b,
    state_count = states, token_work = token_work,
    parameters = list(min_steps = min_steps, max_steps = max_steps, max_skips = max_skips,
      max_source_gap = max_source_gap, max_pairs = max_pairs, max_states = max_states,
      max_results = max_results, max_token_work = max_token_work, max_formulas = max_formulas),
    diagnostics = list(a = doc_a$diagnostics, b = doc_b$diagnostics))
}
# END R/math-sequences.R

# BEGIN R/code.R
# R parsing only: never source, eval, load packages, or invoke submitted calls.
code_positive_integer <- function(x, name) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x) ||
      x < 1 || x != floor(x) || x > .Machine$integer.max)
    stop(paste(name, "must be a representable positive integer."))
  as.integer(x)
}
.code_key <- function(x) paste0(nchar(x, type = "chars"), ":", x, collapse = "|")
.empty_code_tokens <- function() data.frame(token_id = integer(), kind = character(),
  text = character(), start_offset = integer(), end_offset = integer(),
  start_line = integer(), start_column = integer(), end_line = integer(), end_column = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

tokenize_r_code <- function(code, max_chars = 100000L, max_tokens = 20000L, max_nodes = 50000L, max_statements = 2000L) {
  if (!is.character(code) || length(code) != 1L || is.na(code))
    stop("code must be one non-missing character string.")
  max_chars <- code_positive_integer(max_chars, "max_chars")
  max_tokens <- code_positive_integer(max_tokens, "max_tokens")
  max_nodes <- code_positive_integer(max_nodes, "max_nodes")
  max_statements <- code_positive_integer(max_statements, "max_statements")
  code <- gsub("\r\n?", "\n", enc2utf8(code), perl = TRUE)
  chars <- strsplit(code, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]; n <- length(chars)
  if (n > max_chars) stop("Code character limit exceeded.")
  result <- list(source = code, tokens = .empty_code_tokens(), token_count = 0L,
    normalized_key = NA_character_, renamed_key = NA_character_,
    variable_map = data.frame(name = character(), canonical = character()),
    status = "limited", parse_status = "error", rename_status = "unavailable", issues = character(),
    statements = list(), statement_status = "unavailable")
  # Do not interpret submitted source-location directives or follow their filenames.
  if (grepl("(?m)^[ \t]*#line[ \t]+", code, perl = TRUE)) {
    result$parse_status <- "limited"; result$issues <- "unsupported_line_directive"; return(result)
  }
  parsed <- tryCatch(parse(text = code, keep.source = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8"), error = identity)
  if (inherits(parsed, "error")) {
    result$issues <- paste0("parse_error: ", conditionMessage(parsed)); return(result)
  }
  pd <- utils::getParseData(parsed, includeText = FALSE)
  result$parse_status <- "ok"
  if (is.null(pd) || !nrow(pd)) {
    result$status <- "empty"; result$rename_status <- "not_applicable"
    result$statement_status <- "not_applicable"; return(result)
  }
  if (nrow(pd) > max_nodes) stop("Code parse node limit exceeded.")
  terminal <- pd[pd$terminal, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(terminal) > max_tokens) stop("Code token limit exceeded.")
  # includeText=FALSE avoids truncated text for long string literals.
  literal <- tryCatch(unname(utils::getParseText(pd, terminal$id)), error = function(e) NULL)
  cursor <- 1L; starts <- ends <- integer(nrow(terminal)); mapped <- !is.null(literal)
  whitespace <- c(" ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v")
  if (mapped) for (i in seq_len(nrow(terminal))) {
    while (cursor <= n && chars[cursor] %in% whitespace) cursor <- cursor + 1L
    if (is.na(literal[i]) || !nzchar(literal[i])) { mapped <- FALSE; break }
    width <- nchar(literal[i], type = "chars")
    finish <- cursor + width - 1L
    actual <- if (width > 0L && finish <= n) paste0(chars[seq.int(cursor, finish)], collapse = "") else ""
    if (!width || !identical(actual, literal[i])) { mapped <- FALSE; break }
    starts[i] <- cursor; ends[i] <- finish; cursor <- finish + 1L
  }
  while (cursor <= n && chars[cursor] %in% whitespace) cursor <- cursor + 1L
  if (!mapped || cursor <= n) {
    result$parse_status <- "limited"; result$issues <- "token_source_mapping_failed"; return(result)
  }
  line_starts <- c(1L, which(chars == "\n") + 1L)
  line_a <- findInterval(starts, line_starts); line_b <- findInterval(ends, line_starts)
  tokens <- data.frame(token_id = terminal$id, kind = terminal$token, text = literal,
    start_offset = starts, end_offset = ends, start_line = as.integer(line_a),
    start_column = as.integer(starts - line_starts[line_a] + 1L), end_line = as.integer(line_b),
    end_column = as.integer(ends - line_starts[line_b] + 1L), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  result$tokens <- tokens
  ignored <- terminal$token == "COMMENT" | literal == ";"
  included <- pd[!pd$terminal | !pd$id %in% terminal$id[ignored], , drop = FALSE]
  result$token_count <- as.integer(sum(!ignored))
  if (!result$token_count) {
    result$status <- "empty"; result$rename_status <- "not_applicable"
    result$statement_status <- "not_applicable"; return(result)
  }
  node_parent <- match(included$parent, included$id, nomatch = 0L)
  values <- rep("", nrow(included))
  leaves <- included$terminal
  values[leaves] <- literal[match(included$id[leaves], terminal$id)]
  graph_key <- function(v) .code_key(paste(included$token, node_parent, v, sep = "\001"))
  result$normalized_key <- graph_key(values)
  # Keep grammatical parent relationships: newline-sensitive expression boundaries matter.
  issues <- character()
  scope_tokens <- c("FUNCTION", "FOR", "WHILE", "REPEAT", "IF", "ELSE")
  if (any(terminal$token %in% scope_tokens) || any(literal %in% c("<<-", "->", "->>")) ||
      any(terminal$token == "EQ_ASSIGN") || any(literal == "~"))
    issues <- c(issues, "renaming_restricted_scope_or_assignment")
  allowed_calls <- c("c", "mean", "sum", "sd", "var", "median", "min", "max", "length", "sqrt",
    "abs", "log", "exp", "round", "seq", "rep", "sort", "order", "unique", "which", "is.na",
    "as.numeric", "as.integer", "as.character", "numeric", "integer", "character", "matrix", "array",
    "data.frame", "list", "print", "cat", "stop", "warning", "cor", "cov", "sample", "rnorm",
    "runif", "set.seed", "head", "tail", "nrow", "ncol")
  if (any(!literal[terminal$token == "SYMBOL_FUNCTION_CALL"] %in% allowed_calls))
    issues <- c(issues, "renaming_restricted_call")
  if (any(!literal[terminal$token == "SYMBOL_PACKAGE"] %in% c("base", "stats", "utils")))
    issues <- c(issues, "renaming_restricted_namespace")
  inside <- function(node) {
    terminal[(terminal$line1 > node$line1 | (terminal$line1 == node$line1 & terminal$col1 >= node$col1)) &
      (terminal$line2 < node$line2 | (terminal$line2 == node$line2 & terminal$col2 <= node$col2)), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  for (id in terminal$id[literal == "("]) {
    open <- pd[match(id, pd$id), , drop = FALSE]
    children <- pd[pd$parent == open$parent & pd$token != "COMMENT", , drop = FALSE]
    before <- children[children$line2 < open$line1 | (children$line2 == open$line1 & children$col2 < open$col1), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(before) == 1L && before$token == "expr") {
      head_terms <- inside(before)
      if (!all(head_terms$token %in% c("SYMBOL_FUNCTION_CALL", "SYMBOL_PACKAGE", "NS_GET", "NS_GET_INT")) ||
          sum(head_terms$token == "SYMBOL_FUNCTION_CALL") != 1L)
        issues <- c(issues, "renaming_restricted_computed_call")
    }
  }
  candidates <- character(); defining_ids <- integer(); defining_parents <- integer()
  for (id in terminal$id[terminal$token == "LEFT_ASSIGN" & literal == "<-"]) {
    operator <- pd[match(id, pd$id), , drop = FALSE]
    children <- pd[pd$parent == operator$parent & pd$token != "COMMENT", , drop = FALSE]
    left <- children[children$line2 < operator$line1 | (children$line2 == operator$line1 & children$col2 < operator$col1), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(left) != 1L || left$token != "expr") next
    symbol <- pd[pd$parent == left$id & pd$token != "COMMENT", , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(symbol) != 1L || symbol$token != "SYMBOL") next
    name <- literal[match(symbol$id, terminal$id)]
    if (!grepl("^[A-Za-z.][A-Za-z0-9._]*$", name) || name %in% candidates) next
    candidates <- c(candidates, name); defining_ids <- c(defining_ids, symbol$id)
    defining_parents <- c(defining_parents, operator$parent)
  }
  safe <- vapply(seq_along(candidates), function(i) {
    name <- candidates[i]; definition <- match(defining_ids[i], terminal$id)
    # A name used as a function is kept literally throughout the block.
    if (name %in% literal[terminal$token == "SYMBOL_FUNCTION_CALL"]) return(FALSE)
    uses <- which(terminal$token == "SYMBOL" & literal == name)
    if (any(uses < definition)) return(FALSE)
    assign <- pd[match(defining_parents[i], pd$id), , drop = FALSE]
    refs <- inside(assign)
    any_self_reference <- any(refs$id != defining_ids[i] & refs$token == "SYMBOL" &
      literal[match(refs$id, terminal$id)] == name)
    !any_self_reference
  }, logical(1))
  candidates <- candidates[safe]
  # Member names are literal even if they happen to equal a local variable name.
  member <- rep(FALSE, nrow(terminal))
  syntax <- which(terminal$token != "COMMENT")
  if (length(syntax) > 1L) member[syntax[-1L]] <- literal[head(syntax, -1L)] %in% c("$", "@")
