  eligible <- rep(FALSE, nrow(included))
  if (!length(issues)) {
    replaced <- values
    eligible <- included$terminal & included$token == "SYMBOL"
    indices <- match(included$id, terminal$id)
    eligible[eligible] <- !member[indices[eligible]] & values[eligible] %in% candidates
    if (any(eligible)) replaced[eligible] <- paste0("@variable:", match(values[eligible], candidates))
    result$renamed_key <- graph_key(replaced)
    result$variable_map <- data.frame(name = candidates, canonical = if (length(candidates)) paste0("v", seq_along(candidates)) else character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    result$rename_status <- "ok"; result$status <- "ok"
  } else {
    result$rename_status <- "restricted"; result$status <- "limited"
  }
  result$issues <- unique(issues)
  roots <- included[!included$terminal & included$parent == 0L, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(roots) > max_statements) stop("Code statement count limit exceeded.")
  covered <- integer(nrow(terminal)); statements <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(roots))) {
    root <- roots[i, , drop = FALSE]
    within <- function(rows) (rows$line1 > root$line1 | (rows$line1 == root$line1 & rows$col1 >= root$col1)) &
      (rows$line2 < root$line2 | (rows$line2 == root$line2 & rows$col2 <= root$col2))
    token_rows <- which(within(terminal) & !ignored)
    if (!length(token_rows)) next
    node_rows <- which(within(included))
    nodes <- included[node_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    parents <- match(nodes$parent, nodes$id, nomatch = 0L)
    key <- function(v) .code_key(paste(nodes$token, parents, v, sep = "\001"))
    shape <- values[node_rows]
    shape[eligible[node_rows]] <- "@renameable"
    covered[token_rows] <- covered[token_rows] + 1L
    statements[[length(statements) + 1L]] <- list(token_rows = as.integer(token_rows),
      content = substring(code, starts[token_rows[1L]], ends[tail(token_rows, 1L)]),
      normalized_key = key(values[node_rows]),
      shape_key = if (result$rename_status == "ok") key(shape) else NA_character_,
      rename_eligible = eligible[match(terminal$id[token_rows], included$id)])
  }
  if (!length(statements) || any(covered[!ignored] != 1L)) {
    result$status <- "limited"; result$statement_status <- "unavailable"
    result$issues <- unique(c(result$issues, "statement_extraction_failed"))
  } else {
    result$statements <- statements; result$statement_status <- "ok"
  }
  result
}

prepare_code_units <- function(doc, max_units = 500L, max_total_chars = 1000000L) {
  if (!inherits(doc, "rmd_document")) stop("doc must be an rmd_document.")
  max_units <- code_positive_integer(max_units, "max_units")
  max_total_chars <- code_positive_integer(max_total_chars, "max_total_chars")
  units <- doc$units[doc$units$type %in% c("code", "inline_r"), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(units) > max_units) stop("Code unit limit exceeded.")
  if (sum(nchar(units$content, type = "chars")) > max_total_chars) stop("Total code character limit exceeded.")
  details <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(units)), function(i) {
    if (tolower(units$language[i]) != "r") {
      d <- list(source = units$content[i], tokens = .empty_code_tokens(), token_count = 0L,
        normalized_key = NA_character_, renamed_key = NA_character_,
        variable_map = data.frame(name = character(), canonical = character()), status = "limited",
        parse_status = "unsupported", rename_status = "unavailable", issues = "unsupported_code_language")
    } else d <- tokenize_r_code(units$content[i])
    if (units$status[i] != "ok") {
      d$status <- "limited"; d$parse_status <- "limited"; d$rename_status <- "unavailable"
      d$normalized_key <- d$renamed_key <- NA_character_; d$issues <- c(d$issues, "parser_limited")
    }
    if (nrow(d$tokens)) {
      d$tokens$start_offset <- as.integer(d$tokens$start_offset + units$content_start[i] - 1L)
      d$tokens$end_offset <- as.integer(d$tokens$end_offset + units$content_start[i] - 1L)
      source_chars <- strsplit(doc$source, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
      starts <- c(1L, which(source_chars == "\n") + 1L)
      d$tokens$start_line <- as.integer(findInterval(d$tokens$start_offset, starts))
      d$tokens$end_line <- as.integer(findInterval(d$tokens$end_offset, starts))
      d$tokens$start_column <- as.integer(d$tokens$start_offset - starts[d$tokens$start_line] + 1L)
      d$tokens$end_column <- as.integer(d$tokens$end_offset - starts[d$tokens$end_line] + 1L)
    }
    d
  })
  units$code_status <- vapply(details, function(d) d$status, character(1))
  units$token_count <- vapply(details, function(d) d$token_count, integer(1))
  units$details <- I(details)
  units
}

compare_code_pair <- function(doc_a, doc_b, max_pairs = 10000L, max_pair_chars = 5000000L) {
  max_pairs <- code_positive_integer(max_pairs, "max_pairs")
  max_pair_chars <- code_positive_integer(max_pair_chars, "max_pair_chars")
  a <- prepare_code_units(doc_a); b <- prepare_code_units(doc_b)
  na <- nrow(a); nb <- nrow(b)
  if (as.double(na) * nb > max_pairs) stop("Code pair limit exceeded.")
  if (sum(nchar(a$content)) * as.double(nb) + sum(nchar(b$content)) * as.double(na) > max_pair_chars)
    stop("Code pair character work limit exceeded.")
  matches <- data.frame(file_id_a = character(), file_id_b = character(), unit_id_a = character(),
    unit_id_b = character(), raw_equal = logical(), tokens_equal = logical(), renamed_equal = logical(),
    token_count = integer(), start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(),
    start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(), status = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  matches$variable_map <- I(list())
  comments <- data.frame(unit_id_a = character(), unit_id_b = character(), comment_count = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (i in seq_len(na)) for (j in seq_len(nb)) {
    x <- a$details[[i]]; y <- b$details[[j]]
    cx <- x$tokens$text[x$tokens$kind == "COMMENT"]; cy <- y$tokens$text[y$tokens$kind == "COMMENT"]
    if (length(cx) && identical(cx, cy)) comments <- rbind(comments,
      data.frame(unit_id_a = a$unit_id[i], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[j], comment_count = length(cx)))
    raw <- x$status != "empty" && y$status != "empty" && nzchar(trimws(a$content[i])) && identical(a$content[i], b$content[j])
    lexical <- x$parse_status == "ok" && y$parse_status == "ok" && x$token_count > 0L && y$token_count > 0L &&
      identical(x$normalized_key, y$normalized_key)
    renamed <- x$rename_status == "ok" && y$rename_status == "ok" &&
      identical(x$renamed_key, y$renamed_key)
    if (!raw && !lexical && !renamed) next
    row <- data.frame(file_id_a = a$file_id[i], file_id_b = b$file_id[j], unit_id_a = a$unit_id[i], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[j],
      raw_equal = raw, tokens_equal = lexical, renamed_equal = renamed,
      token_count = as.integer(min(x$token_count, y$token_count)), start_line_a = a$start_line[i], end_line_a = a$end_line[i],
      start_line_b = b$start_line[j], end_line_b = b$end_line[j],
      status = if (x$status == "ok" && y$status == "ok") "ok" else "limited", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    row$variable_map <- I(list(if (renamed) data.frame(a = x$variable_map$name, b = y$variable_map$name)
      else data.frame(a = character(), b = character())))
    matches <- rbind(matches, row)
  }
  limited <- any(c(a$code_status, b$code_status) == "limited") ||
    any(c(doc_a$diagnostics$severity, doc_b$diagnostics$severity) %in% c("warning", "error"))
  status <- if (limited) "limited" else if (!na || !nb) "not_applicable" else
    if (any(c(a$code_status, b$code_status) == "empty")) "insufficient_content" else "ok"
  list(status = status, matches = matches, comment_matches = comments, code_a = a, code_b = b,
    parameters = list(max_pairs = max_pairs, max_pair_chars = max_pair_chars),
    diagnostics = list(a = doc_a$diagnostics, b = doc_b$diagnostics))
}
# END R/code.R

# BEGIN R/code-local.R
# Requires parser.R and code.R; all submitted code remains unevaluated.
.code_nonnegative_integer <- function(x, name) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x) ||
      x < 0 || x != floor(x) || x > .Machine$integer.max)
    stop(paste(name, "must be a representable nonnegative integer."))
  as.integer(x)
}

.code_statements_from_units <- function(units, max_statements) {
  result <- data.frame(file_id = character(), unit_id = character(), statement_id = character(),
    statement_index = integer(), content = character(), token_count = integer(),
    normalized_key = character(), shape_key = character(), unit_status = character(),
    start_line = integer(), end_line = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  result$tokens <- I(list()); result$rename_eligible <- I(list())
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(units))) {
    d <- units$details[[i]]
    if (d$parse_status != "ok" || !identical(d$statement_status, "ok")) next
    if (nrow(result) + length(d$statements) > max_statements) stop("Total code statement limit exceeded.")
    for (j in seq_along(d$statements)) {
      s <- d$statements[[j]]; tokens <- d$tokens[s$token_rows, , drop = FALSE]
      row <- data.frame(file_id = units$file_id[i], unit_id = units$unit_id[i],
        statement_id = paste0(units$unit_id[i], ":e", sprintf("%04d", j)), statement_index = as.integer(j),
        content = s$content, token_count = as.integer(nrow(tokens)), normalized_key = s$normalized_key,
        shape_key = s$shape_key, unit_status = d$status, start_line = tokens$start_line[1L],
        end_line = tail(tokens$end_line, 1L), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      row$tokens <- I(list(tokens)); row$rename_eligible <- I(list(s$rename_eligible))
      result <- rbind(result, row)
    }
  }
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  result
}

prepare_code_statements <- function(doc, max_statements = 2000L) {
  max_statements <- code_positive_integer(max_statements, "max_statements")
  .code_statements_from_units(prepare_code_units(doc), max_statements)
}

make_code_windows <- function(statements, window_tokens = 100L, window_statements = 20L, max_windows = 500L) {
  window_tokens <- code_positive_integer(window_tokens, "window_tokens")
  window_statements <- code_positive_integer(window_statements, "window_statements")
  max_windows <- code_positive_integer(max_windows, "max_windows")
  if (window_statements > 20L) stop("window_statements must not exceed 20.")
  if (!is.data.frame(statements) || !all(c("unit_id", "statement_id", "token_count") %in% names(statements)))
    stop("statements must come from prepare_code_statements.")
  result <- data.frame(window_id = character(), unit_id = character(), token_count = integer(), oversize = logical())
  result$statement_indices <- I(list())
  for (unit in unique(statements$unit_id)) {
    indices <- which(statements$unit_id == unit); start <- 1L; n <- length(indices)
    while (start <= n) {
      end <- start; total <- statements$token_count[indices[start]]
      while (end < n && end - start + 1L < window_statements &&
          total + statements$token_count[indices[end + 1L]] <= window_tokens) {
        end <- end + 1L; total <- total + statements$token_count[indices[end]]
      }
      if (nrow(result) >= max_windows) stop("Code window limit exceeded.")
      row <- data.frame(window_id = paste0("w", sprintf("%05d", nrow(result) + 1L)),
        unit_id = unit, token_count = as.integer(total), oversize = total > window_tokens)
      row$statement_indices <- I(list(indices[seq.int(start, end)]))
      result <- rbind(result, row)
      if (end == n) break
      start <- start + max(1L, as.integer(floor((end - start + 1L) / 2)))
    }
  }
  result
}

.code_window_features <- function(statements, windows) {
  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(windows))) for (mode in c("lexical", "renamed")) {
    indices <- windows$statement_indices[[i]]
    keys <- statements[[if (mode == "lexical") "normalized_key" else "shape_key"]][indices]
    keys <- unique(keys[!is.na(keys)])
    if (length(keys)) rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(window_index = i, mode = mode, key = keys)
  }
  if (!length(rows)) return(data.frame(window_index = integer(), mode = character(), key = character()))
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

select_code_candidates <- function(statements_a, statements_b, windows_a, windows_b,
    max_candidates = 500L, max_seed_pairs = 100000L) {
  max_candidates <- code_positive_integer(max_candidates, "max_candidates")
  max_seed_pairs <- code_positive_integer(max_seed_pairs, "max_seed_pairs")
  a <- .code_window_features(statements_a, windows_a); b <- .code_window_features(statements_b, windows_b)
  empty <- data.frame(window_index_a = integer(), window_index_b = integer(), mode = character())
  if (!nrow(a) || !nrow(b)) return(empty)
  ca <- table(paste(a$mode, a$key, sep = "\002")); cb <- table(paste(b$mode, b$key, sep = "\002"))
  common <- intersect(names(ca), names(cb))
  projected <- sum(as.double(ca[common]) * as.double(cb[common]))
  if (projected > max_seed_pairs) stop("Code seed-pair limit exceeded.")
  joined <- merge(a, b, by = c("mode", "key"), suffixes = c("_a", "_b"), sort = FALSE)
  if (!nrow(joined)) return(empty)
  result <- unique(joined[, names(empty), drop = FALSE])
  if (nrow(result) > max_candidates) stop("Code candidate limit exceeded.")
  result <- result[order(result$window_index_a, result$window_index_b, result$mode), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  result
}

.extend_code_mapping <- function(a, b, mode, mapping) {
  if (mode == "lexical") return(if (identical(a$normalized_key, b$normalized_key)) mapping else NULL)
  if (is.na(a$shape_key) || is.na(b$shape_key) || !identical(a$shape_key, b$shape_key)) return(NULL)
  ta <- a$tokens[[1L]]; tb <- b$tokens[[1L]]
  eligible <- a$rename_eligible[[1L]]
  for (k in which(eligible)) {
    x <- ta$text[k]; y <- tb$text[k]; existing <- match(x, mapping$a)
    if (!is.na(existing)) {
      if (mapping$b[existing] != y) return(NULL)
    } else {
      if (y %in% mapping$b) return(NULL)
      mapping <- rbind(mapping, data.frame(a = x, b = y, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  mapping
}

.code_local_matches <- function(a, b, wa, wb, candidates, min_tokens, min_statements,
    max_skips, max_states, max_results, max_token_work) {
  states <- 0; work <- 0; paths <- list(); seen <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  empty_map <- data.frame(a = character(), b = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (ci in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {
    ia <- wa$statement_indices[[candidates$window_index_a[ci]]]
    ib <- wb$statement_indices[[candidates$window_index_b[ci]]]
    mode <- candidates$mode[ci]
    attempt <- function(i, j, mapping) {
      states <<- states + 1; work <<- work + max(a$token_count[ia[i]], b$token_count[ib[j]])
      if (states > max_states) stop("Code local search state limit exceeded.")
      if (work > max_token_work) stop("Code local token work limit exceeded.")
      .extend_code_mapping(a[ia[i], , drop = FALSE], b[ib[j], , drop = FALSE], mode, mapping)
    }
    walk <- function(pa, pb, mapping, skipped) {
      i <- tail(pa, 1L); j <- tail(pb, 1L); extended <- FALSE
      if (i < length(ia) && j < length(ib)) {
        remaining <- max_skips - skipped
        for (di in seq_len(min(as.double(remaining) + 1, length(ia) - i)))
          for (dj in seq_len(min(as.double(remaining) - di + 2, length(ib) - j))) {
            next_map <- attempt(i + di, j + dj, mapping)
            if (is.null(next_map)) next
            extended <- TRUE
            walk(c(pa, i + di), c(pb, j + dj), next_map, skipped + di + dj - 2L)
          }
      }
      aa <- ia[pa]; bb <- ib[pb]
      count <- sum(a$token_count[aa])
      if (extended || length(aa) < min_statements || count < min_tokens) return(invisible(NULL))
      if (mode == "renamed" && all(a$normalized_key[aa] == b$normalized_key[bb])) return(invisible(NULL))
      keys <- paste(a$statement_id[aa], b$statement_id[bb], sep = "=")
      key <- paste(mode, paste(keys, collapse = "/"), sep = ":")
      if (exists(key, envir = seen, inherits = FALSE)) return(invisible(NULL))
      if (length(paths) >= max_results) stop("Code local result limit exceeded.")
      assign(key, TRUE, envir = seen)
      paths[[length(paths) + 1L]] <<- list(a = aa, b = bb, mapping = mapping, mode = mode, keys = keys)
    }
    for (i in seq_along(ia)) for (j in seq_along(ib)) {
      mapping <- attempt(i, j, empty_map)
      if (!is.null(mapping)) walk(i, j, mapping, 0L)
    }
  }
  keep <- vapply(seq_along(paths), function(i) !any(vapply(seq_along(paths), function(j)
    paths[[i]]$mode == paths[[j]]$mode && length(paths[[j]]$a) > length(paths[[i]]$a) &&
      all(paths[[i]]$keys %in% paths[[j]]$keys), logical(1))), logical(1))
  paths <- paths[keep]
  matches <- data.frame(file_id_a = character(), file_id_b = character(), unit_id_a = character(), unit_id_b = character(),
    method = character(), matched_statements = integer(), matched_tokens = integer(), skipped_statements = integer(),
    skipped_tokens = integer(), alignment_ratio = numeric(), start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(),
    start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  list_cols <- c("statement_pairs", "variable_map", "token_starts_a", "token_ends_a", "token_starts_b", "token_ends_b",
    "skipped_statements_a", "skipped_statements_b")
  for (name in list_cols) matches[[name]] <- I(list())
  for (path in paths) {
    aa <- path$a; bb <- path$b
    skipped_a <- setdiff(seq.int(aa[1L], tail(aa, 1L)), aa)
    skipped_b <- setdiff(seq.int(bb[1L], tail(bb, 1L)), bb)
    skipped_tokens <- sum(a$token_count[skipped_a]) + sum(b$token_count[skipped_b])
    total <- sum(a$token_count[aa])
    row <- data.frame(file_id_a = a$file_id[aa[1L]], file_id_b = b$file_id[bb[1L]],
      unit_id_a = a$unit_id[aa[1L]], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[bb[1L]], method = path$mode,
      matched_statements = as.integer(length(aa)), matched_tokens = as.integer(total),
      skipped_statements = as.integer(length(skipped_a) + length(skipped_b)), skipped_tokens = as.integer(skipped_tokens),
      alignment_ratio = total / (total + skipped_tokens), start_line_a = a$start_line[aa[1L]],
      end_line_a = a$end_line[tail(aa, 1L)], start_line_b = b$start_line[bb[1L]], end_line_b = b$end_line[tail(bb, 1L)])
    row$statement_pairs <- I(list(data.frame(statement_id_a = a$statement_id[aa], statement_id_b = b$statement_id[bb],
      content_a = a$content[aa], content_b = b$content[bb], start_line_a = a$start_line[aa], end_line_a = a$end_line[aa],
      start_line_b = b$start_line[bb], end_line_b = b$end_line[bb], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
    row$variable_map <- I(list(path$mapping))
    for (side in c("a", "b")) for (edge in c("start", "end")) {
      table <- if (side == "a") a else b; indices <- if (side == "a") aa else bb
      positions <- as.integer(unlist(lapply(table$tokens[indices], function(t) t[[paste0(edge, "_offset")]]), use.names = FALSE))
      row[[paste0("token_", edge, "s_", side)]] <- I(list(positions))
    }
    row$skipped_statements_a <- I(list(a$statement_id[skipped_a]))
    row$skipped_statements_b <- I(list(b$statement_id[skipped_b]))
    matches <- rbind(matches, row[, names(matches), drop = FALSE])
  }
  if (nrow(matches)) {
    matches <- matches[order(-matches$matched_tokens, matches$skipped_tokens, matches$start_line_a, matches$start_line_b, matches$method), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(matches) <- NULL
  }
  list(matches = matches, state_count = states, token_work = work)
}

.code_local_coverage <- function(doc, units, matches, side, lexical_only) {
  comparable <- as.integer(unlist(lapply(units$details, function(d) {
    if (d$parse_status != "ok") return(integer())
    d$tokens$start_offset[d$tokens$kind != "COMMENT" & d$tokens$text != ";"]
  }), use.names = FALSE))
  comparable <- unique(comparable)
  rows <- if (lexical_only) matches$method == "lexical" else rep(TRUE, nrow(matches))
  matched <- unique(as.integer(unlist(matches[[paste0("token_starts_", side)]][rows], use.names = FALSE)))
  if (!all(matched %in% comparable)) stop("Code coverage contains unknown token positions.")
  data.frame(side = toupper(side), file_id = doc$file_id, comparable_tokens = length(comparable),
    matched_tokens = length(matched), coverage = if (length(comparable)) length(matched) / length(comparable) else NA_real_,
    status = if (length(comparable)) "ok" else "insufficient_tokens", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

supplement_short_code_coverage <- function(local, whole, records) {
  if (is.null(local) || is.null(whole) || is.null(records))
    return(list(coverage = local$coverage, added = 0L))
  short <- records[records$module == "code_whole" & records$eligible &
    records$matched_units >= 3L & records$matched_units < local$parameters$min_tokens, , drop = FALSE]
  pairs <- whole$matches[short$source_row, , drop = FALSE]
  lexical <- pairs$tokens_equal
  preferred <- lexical | (!pairs$unit_id_a %in% pairs$unit_id_a[lexical] &
    !pairs$unit_id_b %in% pairs$unit_id_b[lexical])
  pairs <- pairs[preferred, , drop = FALSE]
  short <- short[preferred, , drop = FALSE]
  unique_pair <- function(ids) !duplicated(ids) & !duplicated(ids, fromLast = TRUE)
  short <- short[unique_pair(pairs$unit_id_a) & unique_pair(pairs$unit_id_b), , drop = FALSE]
  coverage <- local$coverage
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(coverage))) {
    side <- tolower(coverage$side[i])
    positions <- c(local$matches[[paste0("token_starts_", side)]], short[[paste0("positions_", side)]])
    coverage$matched_tokens[i] <- length(unique(unlist(positions, use.names = FALSE)))
  }
  have_tokens <- coverage$comparable_tokens > 0L
  coverage$coverage[have_tokens] <- coverage$matched_tokens[have_tokens] / coverage$comparable_tokens[have_tokens]
  list(coverage = coverage, added = nrow(short))
}

analyze_code_pair_local <- function(doc_a, doc_b, window_tokens = 100L, window_statements = 20L,
    min_tokens = 20L, min_statements = 1L, max_skips = 1L, max_statements = 2000L,
    max_windows = 500L, max_candidates = 500L, max_seed_pairs = 100000L,
    max_states = 50000L, max_results = 1000L, max_token_work = 5000000L) {
  config <- list(window_tokens = window_tokens, window_statements = window_statements, min_tokens = min_tokens,
    min_statements = min_statements, max_statements = max_statements, max_windows = max_windows,
    max_candidates = max_candidates, max_seed_pairs = max_seed_pairs, max_states = max_states,
    max_results = max_results, max_token_work = max_token_work)
  config <- Map(code_positive_integer, config, names(config))
  max_skips <- .code_nonnegative_integer(max_skips, "max_skips"); config$max_skips <- max_skips
  if (config$window_statements > 20L || config$min_statements > config$window_statements)
    stop("Require min_statements <= window_statements <= 20.")
  ua <- prepare_code_units(doc_a); ub <- prepare_code_units(doc_b)
  a <- .code_statements_from_units(ua, config$max_statements)
  b <- .code_statements_from_units(ub, config$max_statements)
  wa <- make_code_windows(a, config$window_tokens, config$window_statements, config$max_windows)
  wb <- make_code_windows(b, config$window_tokens, config$window_statements, config$max_windows)
  candidates <- select_code_candidates(a, b, wa, wb, config$max_candidates, config$max_seed_pairs)
  local <- .code_local_matches(a, b, wa, wb, candidates, config$min_tokens, config$min_statements,
    config$max_skips, config$max_states, config$max_results, config$max_token_work)
  coverage <- rbind(.code_local_coverage(doc_a, ua, local$matches, "a", FALSE), .code_local_coverage(doc_b, ub, local$matches, "b", FALSE))
  lexical <- rbind(.code_local_coverage(doc_a, ua, local$matches, "a", TRUE), .code_local_coverage(doc_b, ub, local$matches, "b", TRUE))
  limited <- any(c(ua$code_status, ub$code_status) == "limited") ||
    any(c(doc_a$diagnostics$severity, doc_b$diagnostics$severity) %in% c("warning", "error"))
  status <- if (limited) "limited" else if (!nrow(ua) || !nrow(ub)) "not_applicable" else
    if (!nrow(a) || !nrow(b)) "insufficient_content" else "ok"
  list(status = status, matches = local$matches, coverage = coverage, lexical_coverage = lexical,
    code_a = ua, code_b = ub, statements_a = a, statements_b = b, windows_a = wa, windows_b = wb,
    candidates = candidates, state_count = local$state_count, token_work = local$token_work, parameters = config,
    diagnostics = list(a = doc_a$diagnostics, b = doc_b$diagnostics))
}
# END R/code-local.R

# BEGIN R/exclusions.R
# Explicit public-source exclusions. Never infer exclusions from shared content.
exclusion_empty_records <- function() data.frame(side = character(), start_line = integer(),
  end_line = integer(), quote = character(), reason = character(), reference = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

exclusion_line_quote <- function(doc, start_line, end_line) {
  chars <- strsplit(doc$source, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  starts <- c(1L, which(chars == "\n") + 1L)
  ends <- c(starts[-1L] - 2L, length(chars))
  for (x in list(start_line, end_line)) if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L ||
      is.na(x) || !is.finite(x) || x < 1 || x != floor(x) || x > length(starts))
    stop("Exclusion line number is outside normalized source.")
  if (start_line > end_line) stop("Exclusion start_line exceeds end_line.")
  substr(doc$source, starts[start_line], ends[end_line])
}

make_exclusion_record <- function(doc, side, start_line, end_line, reason, reference) {
  if (!inherits(doc, "rmd_document")) stop("Expected an rmd_document.")
  data.frame(side = side, start_line = as.integer(start_line), end_line = as.integer(end_line),
    quote = exclusion_line_quote(doc, start_line, end_line), reason = reason,
    reference = reference, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

prepare_document_exclusions <- function(documents, exclusions) {
  if (is.character(exclusions)) {
    if (length(exclusions) != 1L || is.na(exclusions) || !file.exists(exclusions) || dir.exists(exclusions))
      stop("Exclusion CSV file does not exist or is a directory.")
    if (file.info(exclusions)$size > 1000000) stop("Exclusion CSV exceeds 1 MB.")
    exclusions <- utils::read.csv(exclusions, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character",
      fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", check.names = FALSE, na.strings = NULL)
  }
  required <- names(exclusion_empty_records())
  if (!is.data.frame(exclusions) || !all(required %in% names(exclusions)) ||
      !nrow(exclusions) || nrow(exclusions) > 1000L) stop("Expected 1-1000 explicit exclusion records with all required columns.")
  records <- exclusions[, required, drop = FALSE]
  for (name in required) {
    if (is.list(records[[name]]) || anyNA(records[[name]])) stop("Exclusion fields cannot contain missing values or lists.")
    records[[name]] <- enc2utf8(as.character(records[[name]]))
  }
  if (!all(records$side %in% c("A", "B")) || any(!nzchar(trimws(records$reason))) ||
      any(!nzchar(trimws(records$reference)))) stop("Each exclusion needs side A/B, reason, and source reference.")
  for (name in c("start_line", "end_line")) {
    if (!all(grepl("^[1-9][0-9]*$", records[[name]])) || any(as.numeric(records[[name]]) > .Machine$integer.max))
      stop("Exclusion line numbers must be positive integers.")
    records[[name]] <- as.integer(records[[name]])
  }
  records$quote <- gsub("\r\n", "\n", records$quote, fixed = TRUE)
  selected <- list(A = integer(), B = integer()); log <- list()
  comparable_types <- c("text", "math", "code", "inline_r", "inline_code")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(records))) {
    row <- records[i, ]; doc <- documents[[row$side]]
    if (!inherits(doc, "rmd_document")) stop("Both documents must be readable before exclusion.")
    expected <- exclusion_line_quote(doc, row$start_line, row$end_line)
    if (!identical(row$quote, expected)) stop("Exclusion quote mismatch at record ", i, "; source or line range changed.")
    previous <- which(seq_len(nrow(records)) < i & records$side == row$side)
    if (any(records$start_line[previous] <= row$end_line & records$end_line[previous] >= row$start_line))
      stop("Overlapping exclusion ranges on the same side must be combined explicitly.")
    u <- doc$units
    hit <- which(u$start_line <= row$end_line & u$end_line >= row$start_line)
    partial <- hit[u$start_line[hit] < row$start_line | u$end_line[hit] > row$end_line]
    if (length(partial)) stop("Exclusion cuts a parser unit at record ", i, "; cover the complete unit, lines ",
      u$start_line[partial[1L]], "-", u$end_line[partial[1L]], ".")
    if (!any(u$type[hit] %in% comparable_types)) stop("Exclusion selects no text, formula, or code unit.")
    selected[[row$side]] <- c(selected[[row$side]], hit)
    log[[i]] <- data.frame(record = i, side = row$side, unit_id = u$unit_id[hit],
      original_type = u$type[hit], original_status = u$status[hit], start_line = u$start_line[hit], end_line = u$end_line[hit], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  # Validate every record before creating either analysis view.
  .apply_excluded_units(documents, selected, records, do.call(rbind, log))
}

.apply_excluded_units <- function(documents, selected, records, log) {
  # Source/offsets stay intact for reports and sequence boundaries.
  views <- documents
  for (side in c("A", "B")) {
    ids <- unique(selected[[side]])
    views[[side]]$units$type[ids] <- "excluded"
    views[[side]]$units$status[ids] <- "excluded"
    views[[side]]$summary$excluded_units <- length(ids)
    views[[side]]$summary$text_units <- sum(views[[side]]$units$type == "text")
    views[[side]]$summary$math_units <- sum(views[[side]]$units$type == "math")
    views[[side]]$summary$code_units <- sum(views[[side]]$units$type %in% c("code", "inline_r"))
    views[[side]]$summary$limited_units <- sum(views[[side]]$units$status == "limited")
  }
  list(status = "applied", error = "", records = records, units = log, documents = views)
}

prepare_reference_exclusions <- function(documents, path) {
  keys <- function(doc) {
    text <- prepare_text_units(doc)
    math <- prepare_math_units(doc)
    code <- prepare_code_units(doc)
    table <- function(units, key, kind) {
      ok <- units$status == "ok" & !is.na(key) & nzchar(key)
      data.frame(id = units$unit_id[ok], key = paste0(kind, ":", key[ok], recycle0 = TRUE))
    }
    rbind(table(text, text$normalized_text, "text"),
      table(math, vapply(math$details, function(x) if (x$status == "ok") x$normalized_key else NA_character_,
        character(1)), "math"),
      table(code, vapply(code$details, function(x) if (x$parse_status == "ok") x$normalized_key else NA_character_,
        character(1)), "code"))
  }
  reference <- read_rmd(path, file_id = "reference")
  reference_keys <- unique(keys(reference)$key)
  selected <- lapply(documents, function(doc) {
    candidates <- keys(doc)
    which(doc$units$unit_id %in% candidates$id[candidates$key %in% reference_keys])
  })
  reference_name <- basename(path)
  if (!sum(lengths(selected))) return(list(status = "no_matches", error = "",
    records = exclusion_empty_records(), units = data.frame(), documents = documents, reference_name = reference_name))
  records <- list(); log <- list(); offset <- 0L
  for (side in names(documents)) {
    u <- documents[[side]]$units[selected[[side]], , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(u)) next
    log[[side]] <- data.frame(record = offset + seq_len(nrow(u)),
      side = side, unit_id = u$unit_id, original_type = u$type, original_status = u$status,
      start_line = u$start_line, end_line = u$end_line, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    records[[side]] <- data.frame(side = side, start_line = u$start_line, end_line = u$end_line,
      quote = u$raw, reason = "与公共参考的完整单元一致", reference = reference_name, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    offset <- offset + nrow(u)
  }
  result <- .apply_excluded_units(documents, selected, do.call(rbind, records), do.call(rbind, log))
  result$reference_name <- reference_name
  result
}
# END R/exclusions.R

# BEGIN R/evidence.R
# Normalize existing results and conservatively group overlaps. No new matching.
empty_evidence_records <- function() {
  d <- data.frame(record_id = character(), kind = character(), unit = character(), module = character(),
    table = character(), source_row = integer(), method = character(), level = character(),
    eligible = logical(), matched_units = integer(), content_tokens = integer(), similarity = numeric(),
    start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(), start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(),
    group_id = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  d$positions_a <- I(list()); d$positions_b <- I(list()); d
}

group_position_evidence <- function(records, max_records = 100000L, max_atoms = 5000000L) {
  max_records <- code_positive_integer(max_records, "max_records")
  max_atoms <- code_positive_integer(max_atoms, "max_atoms")
  required <- names(empty_evidence_records())
  if (!is.data.frame(records) || !all(required %in% names(records)) || nrow(records) > max_records)
    stop("Invalid evidence schema or record resource limit exceeded.")
  n <- nrow(records); atoms <- 0
  if (!is.logical(records$eligible) || !is.list(records$positions_a) || !is.list(records$positions_b) ||
      anyDuplicated(records$record_id) || anyNA(records$eligible) ||
      !all(records$kind %in% c("text", "math", "code"))) stop("Invalid evidence identities or kinds.")
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    a <- records$positions_a[[i]]; b <- records$positions_b[[i]]
    expected <- switch(records$kind[i], text = "character", math = "step", code = "token")
    if (records$unit[i] != expected || anyNA(a) || anyNA(b) || anyDuplicated(a) || anyDuplicated(b))
      stop("Invalid evidence position units or duplicate/missing atoms.")
    if (records$eligible[i]) {
      if (!length(a) || length(a) != length(b) || records$matched_units[i] != length(a))
        stop("Eligible evidence needs one corresponding position per side.")
      if (records$kind[i] != "math" && (!is.numeric(a) || !is.numeric(b) ||
          any(!is.finite(c(a, b))) || any(c(a, b) < 1 | c(a, b) != floor(c(a, b)))))
        stop("Character/token positions must be positive integers.")
      if (records$kind[i] == "math" && (!is.character(a) || !is.character(b) || any(!nzchar(c(a, b)))))
        stop("Formula step IDs must be nonempty strings.")
    } else if (length(a) || length(b) || records$matched_units[i] != 0L)
      stop("Support-only raw comparisons cannot supply effective position counts.")
    atoms <- atoms + length(a) + length(b)
    if (atoms > max_atoms) stop("Evidence atom resource limit exceeded; no partial grouping.")
  }
  groups <- data.frame(group_id = character(), kind = character(), unit = character(), records = integer(),
    methods = character(), representative_id = character(), largest_match = integer(),
    representative_tokens = integer(), unique_a = integer(), unique_b = integer(),
    start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(), start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  records$group_id <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  active <- which(records$eligible)
  if (!length(active)) return(list(records = records, groups = groups))
  parent <- seq_len(n); seen <- new.env(hash = TRUE, parent = emptyenv())
  root <- function(i) {
    while (parent[i] != i) { parent[i] <<- parent[parent[i]]; i <- parent[i] }
    i
  }
  join <- function(a, b) {
    a <- root(a); b <- root(b)
    if (a != b) parent[max(a, b)] <<- min(a, b)
  }
  for (i in active) for (side in c("a", "b")) {
    keys <- paste(records$kind[i], side, records[[paste0("positions_", side)]][[i]], sep = "|")
    for (key in keys) {
      if (exists(key, envir = seen, inherits = FALSE)) join(i, seen[[key]]) else seen[[key]] <- i
    }
  }
  roots <- vapply(active, root, integer(1)); out <- list()
  for (r in unique(roots)) {
    ids <- active[roots == r]; rows <- records[ids, , drop = FALSE]
    rank <- match(rows$level, c("exact", "raw", "normalized", "lexical", "approximate", "renamed"))
    best <- ids[order(-rows$matched_units, rank, -rows$similarity, ids, na.last = TRUE)[1L]]
    id <- sprintf("g%05d", length(out) + 1L); records$group_id[ids] <- id
    a <- unique(unlist(rows$positions_a, use.names = FALSE)); b <- unique(unlist(rows$positions_b, use.names = FALSE))
    out[[length(out) + 1L]] <- data.frame(group_id = id, kind = rows$kind[1L], unit = rows$unit[1L],
      records = length(ids), methods = paste(sort(unique(rows$method)), collapse = "; "),
      representative_id = records$record_id[best], largest_match = records$matched_units[best],
      representative_tokens = records$content_tokens[best], unique_a = length(a), unique_b = length(b),
      start_line_a = min(rows$start_line_a), end_line_a = max(rows$end_line_a),
      start_line_b = min(rows$start_line_b), end_line_b = max(rows$end_line_b), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  list(records = records, groups = do.call(rbind, out))
}

summarize_pair_evidence <- function(result, max_records = 100000L, max_atoms = 5000000L) {
  max_records <- code_positive_integer(max_records, "max_records")
  max_atoms <- code_positive_integer(max_atoms, "max_atoms")
  modules <- result$modules; rows <- list(); issues <- character(); atoms <- 0
  docs <- result$analysis_documents
  add <- function(kind, module, table, source_row, method, level, row, a, b, eligible = TRUE,
      similarity = 1, content_tokens = NA_integer_) {
    if (length(rows) >= max_records) stop("Evidence record resource limit exceeded.")
    if (!eligible) a <- b <- integer()
    atoms <<- atoms + length(a) + length(b)
    if (atoms > max_atoms) stop("Evidence atom resource limit exceeded.")
    d <- data.frame(record_id = sprintf("e%06d", length(rows) + 1L), kind = kind,
      unit = switch(kind, text = "character", math = "step", code = "token"), module = module,
      table = table, source_row = source_row, method = method, level = level, eligible = eligible,
      matched_units = length(a), content_tokens = content_tokens, similarity = similarity,
      start_line_a = row$start_line_a, end_line_a = row$end_line_a,
      start_line_b = row$start_line_b, end_line_b = row$end_line_b, group_id = NA_character_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    d$positions_a <- I(list(a)); d$positions_b <- I(list(b)); rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <<- d
  }
  text <- modules$text$value
  if (!is.null(text)) for (table in c("exact_matches", "approximate_matches")) {
    matches <- text[[table]]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(matches))) {
      row <- matches[i, ]; exact <- table == "exact_matches"
      add("text", "text", table, i, if (exact) "text_exact" else "text_approximate",
        if (exact) "exact" else "approximate", row, row$source_positions_a[[1L]], row$source_positions_b[[1L]],
        similarity = if (exact) 1 else row$similarity)
    }
  }
  sequence <- modules$formula_sequence$value
  steps <- list()
  for (side in c("a", "b")) {
    steps[[side]] <- if (!is.null(sequence)) sequence[[paste0("formulas_", side)]] else
      tryCatch(prepare_math_steps(docs[[toupper(side)]]), error = function(e) {
        issues <<- c(issues, paste("Formula step view unavailable:", conditionMessage(e))); NULL
      })
  }
  single <- modules$formula_single$value
  if (!is.null(single)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(single$matches))) {
    row <- single$matches[i, ]; selected <- lapply(c("a", "b"), function(side) {
      s <- steps[[side]]
      if (is.null(s)) return(NULL)
      s[s$parent_unit_id == row[[paste0("unit_id_", side)]], , drop = FALSE]
    })
    eligible <- all(vapply(selected, function(s) !is.null(s) && nrow(s) > 0L && all(s$math_status == "ok" & s$token_count > 0L), logical(1))) &&
      isTRUE(row$raw_equal || row$normalized_equal || row$renamed_equal)
    a <- if (eligible) selected[[1L]]$unit_id else character()
    b <- if (eligible) selected[[2L]]$unit_id else character()
    # A whole-unit row with a different number of derived steps remains auxiliary.
    eligible <- eligible && length(a) == length(b)
    level <- if (row$raw_equal) "raw" else if (row$normalized_equal) "normalized" else "renamed"
    add("math", "formula_single", "matches", i, "formula_whole", level, row, a, b, eligible,
      content_tokens = if (eligible) as.integer(sum(selected[[1L]]$token_count)) else 0L)
  }
  if (!is.null(sequence)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(sequence$matches))) {
    row <- sequence$matches[i, ]; pairs <- row$step_pairs[[1L]]
    add("math", "formula_sequence", "matches", i, "formula_sequence",
      if (row$raw_equal) "raw" else if (row$normalized_equal) "normalized" else "renamed", row,
      pairs$unit_id_a, pairs$unit_id_b, similarity = row$step_similarity, content_tokens = row$token_count)
  }
  whole <- modules$code_whole$value
  if (!is.null(whole)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(whole$matches))) {
    row <- whole$matches[i, ]; tokens <- lapply(c("a", "b"), function(side) {
      u <- whole[[paste0("code_", side)]]; d <- u$details[[match(row[[paste0("unit_id_", side)]], u$unit_id)]]
      if (d$parse_status != "ok") return(integer())
      t <- d$tokens; t$start_offset[t$kind != "COMMENT" & t$text != ";"]
    })
    eligible <- length(tokens[[1L]]) > 0L && length(tokens[[1L]]) == length(tokens[[2L]]) &&
      isTRUE(row$raw_equal || row$tokens_equal || row$renamed_equal)
    add("code", "code_whole", "matches", i, "code_whole",
      if (row$raw_equal) "raw" else if (row$tokens_equal) "lexical" else "renamed", row,
      tokens[[1L]], tokens[[2L]], eligible, content_tokens = if (eligible) length(tokens[[1L]]) else 0L)
  }
  local <- modules$code_local$value
  if (!is.null(local)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(local$matches))) {
    row <- local$matches[i, ]
    add("code", "code_local", "matches", i, "code_local", row$method, row,
      row$token_starts_a[[1L]], row$token_starts_b[[1L]], similarity = row$alignment_ratio,
      content_tokens = row$matched_tokens)
  }
  records <- if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows) else empty_evidence_records()
  grouped <- group_position_evidence(records, max_records, max_atoms)
  statuses <- vapply(modules, function(m) m$status, character(1))
  list(status = if (length(issues) || any(statuses %in% c("error", "limited", "not_run"))) "limited" else "ok",
    records = grouped$records, groups = grouped$groups, issues = unique(issues),
    scope = "current_modules_only", support_only_count = sum(!records$eligible),
    note = "Groups share positions on at least one side. They do not prove statistical independence, one consistent mapping across records, or plagiarism. Use a real representative record for match length; never combine different records into an invented alignment.")
}
# END R/evidence.R

# BEGIN R/decision.R
# Draft tri-state rules over existing evidence. Not calibrated or enabled as final verdict.
decision_rules_v1 <- function() list(version = "development-v1",
  text_min_similarity = 0.9, code_min_similarity = 0.8, formula_min_step_similarity = 0.75,
  text_strong_chars = 100L, text_medium_chars = 60L, text_review_chars = 30L,
  text_cumulative_chars = 120L, code_strong_tokens = 60L, code_renamed_strong_tokens = 80L,
  code_medium_tokens = 40L, code_renamed_medium_tokens = 60L, code_review_tokens = 20L,
  code_cumulative_tokens = 100L, code_renamed_cumulative_tokens = 160L,
  formula_strong_steps = 4L, formula_strong_tokens = 40L,
  formula_renamed_strong_steps = 5L, formula_renamed_strong_tokens = 60L,
  formula_medium_steps = 2L, formula_medium_tokens = 20L, formula_renamed_medium_tokens = 30L,
  cumulative_min_groups = 2L, cumulative_min_coverage = 0.3, context_max_line_gap = 10L)

validate_decision_rules <- function(rules) {
  expected <- names(decision_rules_v1())
  if (!is.list(rules) || is.null(names(rules)) || anyDuplicated(names(rules)) ||
      !setequal(names(rules), expected)) stop("Decision rules need the complete, uniquely named draft schema.")
  if (!is.character(rules$version) || length(rules$version) != 1L || is.na(rules$version) || !nzchar(rules$version))
    stop("Decision rule version must be a nonempty string.")
  rates <- c("text_min_similarity", "code_min_similarity", "formula_min_step_similarity", "cumulative_min_coverage")
  for (name in setdiff(expected, c("version", rates, "context_max_line_gap")))
    rules[[name]] <- code_positive_integer(rules[[name]], name)
  for (name in rates) {
    x <- rules[[name]]
    if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x) || x < 0 || x > 1)
      stop(name, " must lie in [0,1].")
  }
  gap <- rules$context_max_line_gap
  if (!is.numeric(gap) || length(gap) != 1L || is.na(gap) || !is.finite(gap) ||
      gap < 0 || gap != floor(gap) || gap > .Machine$integer.max) stop("Invalid context line gap.")
  if (rules$cumulative_min_groups < 2L || rules$text_strong_chars < rules$text_medium_chars ||
      rules$text_medium_chars < rules$text_review_chars || rules$code_medium_tokens < rules$code_review_tokens ||
      rules$code_strong_tokens < rules$code_medium_tokens ||
      rules$code_renamed_strong_tokens < rules$code_strong_tokens ||
      rules$code_renamed_medium_tokens < rules$code_medium_tokens ||
      rules$code_renamed_strong_tokens < rules$code_renamed_medium_tokens ||
      rules$formula_strong_steps < rules$formula_medium_steps ||
      rules$formula_strong_tokens < rules$formula_medium_tokens ||
      rules$formula_renamed_strong_steps < rules$formula_strong_steps ||
      rules$formula_renamed_strong_tokens < rules$formula_strong_tokens ||
      rules$formula_renamed_medium_tokens < rules$formula_medium_tokens ||
      rules$formula_renamed_strong_tokens < rules$formula_renamed_medium_tokens ||
      rules$text_cumulative_chars < rules$text_medium_chars * rules$cumulative_min_groups ||
      rules$code_cumulative_tokens < rules$code_medium_tokens * rules$cumulative_min_groups ||
      rules$code_renamed_cumulative_tokens < rules$code_renamed_medium_tokens * rules$cumulative_min_groups)
    stop("Decision threshold hierarchy is inconsistent.")
  rules
}

evaluate_candidate_decision <- function(result, rules = decision_rules_v1(), max_support_checks = 100000L) {
  rules <- validate_decision_rules(rules)
  max_support_checks <- code_positive_integer(max_support_checks, "max_support_checks")
  limitations <- c("开发规则未经独立答案及保留集效果标定，不是已验证的最终判定。",
    "相似内容可能来自共同题干、标准解法或其他公共来源；不能证明抄袭或复制方向。")
  if (result$exclusions$status == "applied") limitations <- c(limitations, "已按操作者标注排除公共来源；程序不验证其来源真实性。") else
    limitations <- c(limitations, "未应用公共来源排除，共同内容仍可能触发开发试判。")
  empty_triggers <- data.frame(record_id = character(), group_id = character(), kind = character(),
    method = character(), level = character(), matched_units = integer(), content_tokens = integer(),
    similarity = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  adequacy <- data.frame(kind = character(), unit = character(), comparable_a = numeric(),
    comparable_b = numeric(), required = numeric(), sufficient = logical(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  finish <- function(verdict, pathway, reasons, trigger = NULL) {
    labels <- c(suspected = "疑似抄袭", no_clear_evidence = "未检出明显证据", insufficient_evidence = "证据不足")
    if (is.null(trigger)) trigger <- empty_triggers else
      trigger <- trigger[, names(empty_triggers), drop = FALSE]
    list(status = "ok", stage = "development_unvalidated", verdict = verdict, label = unname(labels[verdict]),
      pathway = pathway, reasons = reasons, limitations = limitations, rules = rules,
      trigger_records = trigger, adequacy = adequacy, max_support_checks = max_support_checks)
  }
  if (any(result$manifest$read_status != "ok"))
    return(finish("insufficient_evidence", "input_unavailable", "至少一份输入未成功读取，没有可用于比较的两份完整输入。"))
  if (result$exclusions$status == "error")
    return(finish("insufficient_evidence", "invalid_exclusion", "公共来源排除标注未通过，排除后分析没有运行。"))
  if (is.null(result$evidence$value) || result$evidence$status %in% c("error", "not_run"))
    return(finish("insufficient_evidence", "evidence_unavailable", "证据整理未完成，不能用缺失结果替代零匹配。"))
  evidence <- result$evidence$value; records <- evidence$records
  flags <- vapply(result$modules, function(m) m$status, character(1))
  incomplete <- any(flags %in% c("limited", "error", "not_run")) || result$evidence$status == "limited" ||
    result$overall_status %in% c("limited", "partial_failure")
  if (incomplete) limitations <- c(limitations, paste("存在受限或未完成分析；当前模块状态：", paste(names(flags), flags, collapse = "; ")))
  denominator <- function(kind) {
    value <- result$modules[[if (kind == "text") "text" else "code_local"]]$value
    column <- if (kind == "text") "comparable_chars" else "comparable_tokens"
    if (is.null(value) || !is.data.frame(value$coverage)) return(c(A = NA_real_, B = NA_real_))
    setNames(vapply(c("A", "B"), function(side) {
      x <- value$coverage[[column]][value$coverage$side == side]
      if (length(x) == 1L) as.numeric(x) else NA_real_
    }, numeric(1)), c("A", "B"))
  }
  text_denominator <- denominator("text"); code_denominator <- denominator("code")
  math <- result$modules$formula_sequence$value
  math_count <- function(tokens = FALSE) setNames(vapply(c("a", "b"), function(side) {
    if (is.null(math)) return(NA_real_)
    u <- math[[paste0("formulas_", side)]]; ok <- u$math_status == "ok" & u$token_count > 0L
    if (tokens) as.numeric(sum(u$token_count[ok])) else as.numeric(sum(ok))
  }, numeric(1)), c("A", "B"))
  math_steps <- math_count(); math_tokens <- math_count(TRUE)
  add_adequacy <- function(kind, unit, values, required) data.frame(kind = kind, unit = unit,
    comparable_a = values[1L], comparable_b = values[2L], required = required,
    sufficient = isTRUE(all(values >= required)), row.names = NULL)
  adequacy <- rbind(add_adequacy("text", "character", text_denominator, rules$text_medium_chars),
    add_adequacy("code", "token", code_denominator, rules$code_medium_tokens),
    add_adequacy("math", "step", math_steps, rules$formula_strong_steps),
    add_adequacy("math", "token", math_tokens, rules$formula_strong_tokens))
  sufficient <- adequacy$sufficient[1L] || adequacy$sufficient[2L] || all(adequacy$sufficient[3:4])
  quality_required <- ifelse(records$kind == "text", rules$text_min_similarity,
    ifelse(records$kind == "code", rules$code_min_similarity, rules$formula_min_step_similarity))
  r <- records[records$eligible & records$similarity >= quality_required, , drop = FALSE]
  if (anyNA(r$group_id)) stop("Eligible evidence lacks position groups.")
  if (nrow(r)) r <- r[order(-r$matched_units, r$record_id), , drop = FALSE]
  renamed <- r$level == "renamed"
  strong <- (r$kind == "text" & r$matched_units >= rules$text_strong_chars) |
    (r$kind == "code" & r$matched_units >= ifelse(renamed, rules$code_renamed_strong_tokens, rules$code_strong_tokens)) |
    (r$kind == "math" & r$matched_units >= ifelse(renamed, rules$formula_renamed_strong_steps, rules$formula_strong_steps) &
      !is.na(r$content_tokens) & r$content_tokens >= ifelse(renamed, rules$formula_renamed_strong_tokens, rules$formula_strong_tokens))
  if (any(strong)) {
    chosen <- r[which(strong)[1L], , drop = FALSE]
    return(finish("suspected", paste0("single_", chosen$kind),
      paste("单处匹配达到当前开发长度及相似条件；核查原始记录", chosen$record_id, "，内容类型", chosen$kind, "。"), chosen))
  }
  medium <- (r$kind == "text" & r$matched_units >= rules$text_medium_chars) |
    (r$kind == "code" & r$matched_units >= ifelse(renamed, rules$code_renamed_medium_tokens, rules$code_medium_tokens)) |
    (r$kind == "math" & r$matched_units >= rules$formula_medium_steps & !is.na(r$content_tokens) &
      r$content_tokens >= ifelse(renamed, rules$formula_renamed_medium_tokens, rules$formula_medium_tokens))
  medium <- r[medium, , drop = FALSE]
  # Select real records from distinct position groups. Never use group unions as a single match.
  for (kind in c("text", "code")) {
    available <- medium[medium$kind == kind, , drop = FALSE]
    selections <- if (kind == "code") list(available[available$level != "renamed", , drop = FALSE], available) else list(available)
    for (candidates in selections) {
    candidates <- candidates[!duplicated(candidates$group_id), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(candidates) < rules$cumulative_min_groups) next
    d <- if (kind == "text") text_denominator else code_denominator
    if (anyNA(d) || any(d <= 0)) next
    n <- vapply(c("a", "b"), function(side)
      length(unique(unlist(candidates[[paste0("positions_", side)]], use.names = FALSE))), integer(1))
    coverage <- n / d
    if (any(coverage > 1)) stop("Candidate coverage exceeds its comparable denominator.")
    minimum <- if (kind == "text") rules$text_cumulative_chars else
      if (any(candidates$level == "renamed")) rules$code_renamed_cumulative_tokens else rules$code_cumulative_tokens
    if (all(n >= minimum) && any(coverage >= rules$cumulative_min_coverage))
      return(finish("suspected", paste0("cumulative_", kind),
        paste("多个非重叠位置组达到开发累计条件；实际对应数量A/B：", paste(n, collapse = "/"),
          "；当前范围覆盖A/B：", paste(format(coverage, digits = 3), collapse = "/"), "。"), candidates))
    }
  }
  # Cross-type support is a conjunction of two methods, never an average or unit sum.
  gap <- function(a_start, a_end, b_start, b_end) max(0L, b_start - a_end - 1L, a_start - b_end - 1L)
  line_starts <- lapply(result$analysis_documents, function(doc) {
    c(1L, which(strsplit(doc$source, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]] == "\n") + 1L)
  })
  line_cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv()); step_cache <- list()
  matched_lines <- function(row) {
    id <- row$record_id
    if (exists(id, line_cache, inherits = FALSE)) return(line_cache[[id]])
    positions <- list(a = row$positions_a[[1L]], b = row$positions_b[[1L]])
    bounds <- list()
    for (side in c("a", "b")) {
      if (row$kind == "math") {
        if (is.null(step_cache[[side]])) step_cache[[side]] <<- if (!is.null(math)) math[[paste0("formulas_", side)]] else
          prepare_math_steps(result$analysis_documents[[toupper(side)]])
        u <- step_cache[[side]]; index <- match(positions[[side]], u$unit_id)
        if (anyNA(index)) stop("Decision context references unknown formula steps.")
        bounds[[side]] <- data.frame(start = u$start_line[index], end = u$end_line[index])
      } else {
        lines <- findInterval(positions[[side]], line_starts[[toupper(side)]])
        bounds[[side]] <- data.frame(start = lines, end = lines)
      }
    }
    out <- unique(data.frame(start_a = bounds$a$start, end_a = bounds$a$end,
      start_b = bounds$b$start, end_b = bounds$b$end))
    line_cache[[id]] <- out; out
  }
  work <- 0
  near <- function(i, j) {
    a <- matched_lines(medium[i, , drop = FALSE]); b <- matched_lines(medium[j, , drop = FALSE])
    for (k in seq_len(nrow(a))) {
      work <<- work + nrow(b)
      if (work > max_support_checks) stop("Decision context work resource limit exceeded; no negative conclusion produced.")
      close_a <- b$start_a <= as.double(a$end_a[k]) + rules$context_max_line_gap + 1 &
        b$end_a >= as.double(a$start_a[k]) - rules$context_max_line_gap - 1
      close_b <- b$start_b <= as.double(a$end_b[k]) + rules$context_max_line_gap + 1 &
        b$end_b >= as.double(a$start_b[k]) - rules$context_max_line_gap - 1
      if (any(close_a & close_b)) return(TRUE)
    }
    FALSE
  }
  by_kind <- split(seq_len(nrow(medium)), medium$kind)
  kinds <- names(by_kind)
  if (length(kinds) >= 2L) for (ka in seq_len(length(kinds) - 1L)) for (kb in seq.int(ka + 1L, length(kinds))) {
    # Bound prefix scans and actual paired-line checks; never materialize an unbounded Cartesian join.
    ia <- by_kind[[kinds[ka]]]; ib <- by_kind[[kinds[kb]]]
    ib <- ib[order(medium$start_line_a[ib], medium$record_id[ib])]
    starts <- medium$start_line_a[ib]
    for (i in ia) {
      hi <- findInterval(as.double(medium$end_line_a[i]) + rules$context_max_line_gap + 1, starts)
      if (!hi) next
      work <- work + hi
      if (work > max_support_checks) stop("Decision context work resource limit exceeded; no negative conclusion produced.")
      js <- ib[seq_len(hi)]
      js <- js[medium$end_line_a[js] >= medium$start_line_a[i] - rules$context_max_line_gap - 1]
      for (j in js) if (gap(medium$start_line_b[i], medium$end_line_b[i], medium$start_line_b[j], medium$end_line_b[j]) <= rules$context_max_line_gap && near(i, j))
        return(finish("suspected", "cross_type_support",
          "两类达标片段在两份作业中均位于邻近范围，形成开发规则的联合支持；单位没有相加，映射没有合并。", medium[c(i, j), , drop = FALSE]))
    }
  }
  if (incomplete) return(finish("insufficient_evidence", "analysis_limited", "未触发较强证据路径，且存在分析受限或失败，不能据此给出未检出结论。"))
  if (!sufficient) return(finish("insufficient_evidence", "content_too_short", "两侧同类可比较内容不足当前开发要求；高覆盖或原文相同不能替代有效内容量。"))
  review <- records[records$eligible, , drop = FALSE]
  unresolved <- nrow(medium) > 0L || any(review$kind == "text" & review$matched_units >= rules$text_review_chars) ||
    any(review$kind == "code" & review$matched_units >= rules$code_review_tokens) ||
    any(review$kind == "math" & review$matched_units >= rules$formula_medium_steps & !is.na(review$content_tokens) & review$content_tokens >= rules$formula_medium_tokens)
  if (unresolved) return(finish("insufficient_evidence", "unresolved_matches", "存在值得核查的匹配，但未满足单处、累计或跨类型支持条件；未达候选相似门槛的局部片段也不冒充零匹配。"))
  finish("no_clear_evidence", "no_qualifying_evidence", "当前可比较内容达到开发最低要求，已完成范围内未检出满足候选规则的明显证据；不代表证明无抄袭。")
}
# END R/decision.R

# BEGIN R/report.R
# Evidence report integration. Submitted Rmd files are read only by read_rmd().
report_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- enc2utf8(as.character(x)); x[is.na(x)] <- "不适用"
  for (pair in list(c("&", "&amp;"), c("<", "&lt;"), c(">", "&gt;"),
      c("\"", "&quot;"), c("'", "&#39;"), c("`", "&#96;")))
    x <- gsub(pair[1L], pair[2L], x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

.report_module <- function(fun) {
  warnings <- character()
  value <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(fun(), warning = function(w) {
    warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  }), error = identity)
  if (inherits(value, "error")) return(list(status = "error", error = conditionMessage(value), warnings = warnings, value = NULL))
  list(status = if (length(warnings) && value$status == "ok") "limited" else value$status,
    error = "", warnings = unique(warnings), value = value)
}

.report_run_modules <- function(docs, text_options, formula_options, code_options) {
  args <- list(doc_a = docs$A, doc_b = docs$B)
  list(
    text = .report_module(function() do.call(analyze_text_pair_approx, c(args, text_options))),
    formula_single = .report_module(function() do.call(compare_math_pair, args)),
    formula_sequence = .report_module(function() do.call(find_math_sequences, c(args, formula_options))),
    code_whole = .report_module(function() do.call(compare_code_pair, args)),
    code_local = .report_module(function() do.call(analyze_code_pair_local, c(args, code_options)))
  )
}

analyze_rmd_pair <- function(input_a, input_b, text_options = list(), formula_options = list(), code_options = list(),
    exclusions = NULL, public_reference = NULL) {
  for (options in list(text_options, formula_options, code_options)) {
    if (!is.list(options) || (length(options) && (is.null(names(options)) || any(!nzchar(names(options))) || anyDuplicated(names(options)))))
      stop("Module options must be named lists with unique names.")
  }
  if (any(c("doc_a", "doc_b") %in% c(names(text_options), names(formula_options), names(code_options))))
    stop("Input documents cannot be overridden through module options.")
  inputs <- list(A = input_a, B = input_b)
  docs <- lapply(names(inputs), function(id)
    tryCatch(read_rmd(inputs[[id]], file_id = id, keep_bytes = TRUE), error = identity))
  names(docs) <- names(inputs)
  files_identical <- if (all(vapply(docs, inherits, logical(1), "rmd_document")))
    identical(docs$A$input_bytes, docs$B$input_bytes) else NA
  for (id in names(docs)) {
    if (inherits(docs[[id]], "rmd_document")) docs[[id]]$input_bytes <- NULL
  }
  manifest <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(inputs), function(id) {
    d <- docs[[id]]; ok <- inherits(d, "rmd_document"); path <- inputs[[id]]
    data.frame(file_id = id, filename = if (is.character(path) && length(path) == 1L && !is.na(path)) basename(path) else "无效路径",
      read_status = if (ok) "ok" else "error", characters = if (ok) d$summary$characters else NA_integer_,
      units = if (ok) nrow(d$units) else NA_integer_, diagnostics = if (ok) nrow(d$diagnostics) else NA_integer_,
      message = if (ok) "" else conditionMessage(d), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  skip <- function(message = "两份输入均成功读取后才运行分析。")
    list(status = "not_run", error = message, warnings = character(), value = NULL)
  modules <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(5L), function(i) skip()), c("text", "formula_single", "formula_sequence", "code_whole", "code_local"))
  requested <- !(is.null(exclusions) || identical(exclusions, ""))
  reference_requested <- !(is.null(public_reference) || identical(public_reference, ""))
  if (requested && reference_requested) stop("Use either a public Rmd reference or a CSV exclusion plan.")
  requested <- requested || reference_requested
  info <- list(status = if (requested) "not_run" else "not_requested", error = "",
    records = exclusion_empty_records(), units = data.frame())
  baseline <- NULL; analysis_docs <- docs
  if (all(manifest$read_status == "ok")) {
    if (requested) {
      baseline <- .report_run_modules(docs, text_options, formula_options, code_options)
      plan <- tryCatch(if (reference_requested) prepare_reference_exclusions(docs, public_reference) else
        prepare_document_exclusions(docs, exclusions), error = identity)
      if (inherits(plan, "error")) {
        info$status <- "error"; info$error <- conditionMessage(plan)
        modules <- lapply(modules, function(m) skip("公共来源排除配置无效，未运行排除后分析。"))
      } else {
        analysis_docs <- plan$documents; info <- plan; info$documents <- NULL
        modules <- if (info$status == "no_matches") baseline else
          .report_run_modules(analysis_docs, text_options, formula_options, code_options)
      }
    } else modules <- .report_run_modules(docs, text_options, formula_options, code_options)
  }
  statuses <- c(vapply(modules, function(m) m$status, character(1)),
    vapply(baseline, function(m) m$status, character(1)))
  overall <- if (any(manifest$read_status == "error")) "input_error" else if (info$status == "error") "exclusion_error" else
    if (any(statuses == "error")) "partial_failure" else if (any(statuses == "limited")) "limited" else "completed"
  result <- list(engine_version = "0.6.0-dev", verdict = "not_enabled", overall_status = overall,
    files_identical = files_identical,
    manifest = manifest, documents = docs, analysis_documents = analysis_docs, exclusions = info,
    baseline_modules = baseline, modules = modules,
    requested_options = list(text = text_options, formula_sequence = formula_options, code_local = code_options),
    r_version = as.character(getRversion()))
  result$evidence <- if (all(manifest$read_status == "ok") && info$status != "error")
    .report_module(function() summarize_pair_evidence(result)) else skip("输入或排除配置无效，未整理证据。")
  if (result$evidence$status == "error") result$overall_status <- "partial_failure"
  code_coverage <- supplement_short_code_coverage(modules$code_local$value, modules$code_whole$value,
    result$evidence$value$records)
  result$code_coverage_with_short <- code_coverage$coverage
  result$short_code_matches <- code_coverage$added
  result$decision <- tryCatch(evaluate_candidate_decision(result), error = function(e)
    list(status = "error", stage = "development_unvalidated", verdict = "insufficient_evidence", label = "证据不足",
      pathway = "decision_error", reasons = paste("开发规则评估失败：", conditionMessage(e)),
      limitations = "规则尚未完成效果标定；失败不视为零匹配。", rules = decision_rules_v1(),
      trigger_records = data.frame(), adequacy = data.frame()))
  if (result$decision$status == "error") result$overall_status <- "partial_failure"
  result
}

.report_table <- function(df) {
  if (!is.data.frame(df) || !nrow(df)) return("<p class='muted'>没有对应条目。</p>")
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) paste0("<tr>", paste0("<td>", report_escape(vapply(df, function(col)
    if (is.na(col[i])) "不适用" else as.character(col[i]), character(1))), "</td>", collapse = ""), "</tr>"), character(1))
  paste0("<div class='table-wrap'><table><thead><tr>", paste0("<th>", report_escape(names(df)), "</th>", collapse = ""),
    "</tr></thead><tbody>", paste0(rows, collapse = ""), "</tbody></table></div>")
}
.report_pre <- function(text, max_chars = 4000L) {
  text <- paste0(text, collapse = "\n")
  clipped <- nchar(text, type = "chars") > max_chars
  paste0("<pre><code>", report_escape(substr(text, 1L, max_chars)), "</code></pre>",
    if (clipped) "<p class='muted'>展示已截断至4000字符；分析仍使用完整片段。</p>" else "")
}
.report_pair <- function(a, b, label_a = "A", label_b = "B") paste0("<div class='evidence-pair'><div><h4>",
  report_escape(label_a), "</h4>", .report_pre(a), "</div><div><h4>", report_escape(label_b), "</h4>", .report_pre(b), "</div></div>")
.report_source <- function(doc, positions) {
  positions <- positions[!is.na(positions)]
  if (!length(positions)) "" else substring(doc$source, min(positions), max(positions))
}
.report_params <- function(x, prefix = "") {
  if (!length(x)) return(data.frame(parameter = character(), value = character()))
  rows <- lapply(names(x), function(name) {
    key <- if (nzchar(prefix)) paste(prefix, name, sep = ".") else name
    if (is.list(x[[name]])) .report_params(x[[name]], key) else
      data.frame(parameter = key, value = paste(as.character(x[[name]]), collapse = ", "), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}


.report_scope_summary <- function(modules, stage) {
  rows <- list()
  for (name in names(modules)) {
    m <- modules[[name]]; v <- m$value
    messages <- c(m$error, m$warnings, v$approximate_error)
    messages <- paste(messages[nzchar(messages)], collapse = "; ")
    coverage <- if (name == "text" && !is.null(v$coverage_with_short)) v$coverage_with_short else
      if (name %in% c("text", "code_local")) v$coverage else NULL
    if (!is.null(coverage) && nrow(coverage)) {
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(coverage))) {
        c <- coverage[i, ]; text <- name == "text"
        rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(stage = stage, method = name, side = c$side, status = m$status,
          unit = if (text) "character" else "token", comparable = c[[if (text) "comparable_chars" else "comparable_tokens"]],
          matched = c[[if (text) "matched_chars" else "matched_tokens"]], coverage = c$coverage, match_entries = NA_integer_, message = messages)
      }
    } else rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(stage = stage, method = name, side = "-", status = m$status,
      unit = "match_entries", comparable = NA_integer_, matched = NA_integer_, coverage = NA_real_,
      match_entries = if (is.null(v)) NA_integer_ else nrow(v$matches), message = messages)
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# Display existing decision data only; do not recompute or change the rules.
.report_analysis_overview <- function(result) {
  d <- result$decision
  modules <- result$modules
  reason <- if (is.null(d)) "本次没有生成候选结论。" else switch(d$pathway,
    single_text = "一处文字匹配达到复核条件。请对照下方原文，核查是否来自共同题干或引用。",
    single_math = "一处公式或推导匹配达到复核条件。请对照下方原文，核查是否属于常见解法。",
    single_code = "一处 R 代码匹配达到复核条件。请对照下方原文，核查是否使用了同一份模板或常见写法。",
    cumulative_text = "多处独立位置的文字匹配合计达到复核条件。下方列出了这些片段。",
    cumulative_code = "多处独立位置的 R 代码匹配合计达到复核条件。下方列出了这些片段。",
    cross_type_support = "不同类型的相似片段在两份作业中都出现在相近位置，值得放在一起复核。",
    input_unavailable = "至少有一份作业未能读取。请检查文件格式和编码后再试。",
    invalid_exclusion = "公共来源排除配置有误。请检查配置后再试。",
    evidence_unavailable = "本次未能整理匹配证据，请查看技术详情。",
    analysis_limited = "部分比较受限或未完成，现有证据不足以判断。",
    content_too_short = "两份作业中可用于比较的同类内容太少。",
    unresolved_matches = "发现了值得查看的相似片段，但证据不足以给出更明确的判断。",
    no_qualifying_evidence = "在本次可比较的内容中，未发现达到复核条件的相似片段。",
    decision_error = "本次未能生成候选结论，请查看技术详情。",
    "请结合下面的各项结果和原文片段复核。")
  coverage <- function(module, label, noun, matched, comparable, rows = NULL) {
    if (module$status == "not_run") return(paste0(label, "比较未运行。"))
    if (module$status == "error") return(paste0(label, "比较未完成。原因见对应分析详情。"))
    if (is.null(rows)) rows <- module$value$coverage
    if (module$status %in% c("not_applicable", "insufficient_ngrams", "insufficient_content") ||
        is.null(rows) || anyNA(rows$coverage)) {
      message <- paste0("至少有一份作业的", label, "内容不足，无法给出两侧覆盖比例。")
    } else {
      values <- sprintf("作业 %s %s%%（%d / %d）", rows$side,
        format(round(rows$coverage * 100, 1), trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE),
        rows[[matched]], rows[[comparable]])
      message <- paste0(noun, "的证据覆盖率为 ", paste(values, collapse = "，"), "。")
    }
    if (identical(module$value$approximate_status, "resource_limit")) {
      paste0(message, "近似比较超出资源上限，当前结果来自已完成的精确比较。")
    } else if (module$status == "limited") {
      paste0(message, "部分比较方式或内容受限。")
    } else message
  }
  formula <- function(module, label) switch(module$status,
    not_run = paste0(label, "未运行。"),
    error = paste0(label, "未完成。"),
    not_applicable = paste0(label, "缺少可比较的内容。"),
    insufficient_steps = "推导步骤不足，无法进行多步比较。",
    paste0(label, "找到 ", nrow(module$value$matches), " 条对应记录。",
      if (module$status == "limited") "部分比较方式或内容受限。"))
  rows <- data.frame(
    "比较内容" = c("文字", "公式", "R 代码"),
    "本次发现" = c(
      coverage(modules$text, "文字", "匹配字符", "matched_chars", "comparable_chars",
        modules$text$value$coverage_with_short),
      paste0(formula(modules$formula_single, "完整公式比较"),
        formula(modules$formula_sequence, "推导步骤比较")),
      paste0(coverage(modules$code_local, "代码", "匹配的代码元素（含变量一致改名）",
        "matched_tokens", "comparable_tokens", result$code_coverage_with_short),
        formula(modules$code_whole, "完整代码块比较"))),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  exclusions <- if (identical(result$exclusions$status, "applied") && !is.null(result$exclusions$reference_name)) {
    paste0("已按公共参考排除 ", nrow(result$exclusions$units), " 个完整单元。上表仅统计剩余内容。")
  } else if (identical(result$exclusions$status, "applied")) {
    "已按提供的标注排除公共内容。上表统计排除后的结果。"
  } else if (identical(result$exclusions$status, "no_matches")) {
    "两份作业中均未找到与公共参考一致的完整单元，比较范围没有缩小。"
  } else if (identical(result$exclusions$status, "not_requested") && all(result$manifest$read_status == "ok")) {
    "本次没有排除共同题干或模板，这些内容也可能产生匹配。"
  } else ""
  files <- paste0("<div><dt>作业 ", report_escape(result$manifest$file_id),
    "</dt><dd>", report_escape(result$manifest$filename), "</dd></div>", collapse = "")
  identity_notice <- if (isTRUE(result$files_identical)) paste0(
    "<p class='notice'><strong>文件内容完全相同（100%）</strong>。已逐字节核对两份原始文件。</p>") else ""
  paste0("<dl class='report-files'>", files, "</dl>",
    identity_notice,
    "<div class='notice report-outcome'><strong>候选结论　",
    report_escape(if (is.null(d)) "未生成" else d$label), "</strong><p>", report_escape(reason),
    "</p><p class='muted'>未启用最终判定。当前规则尚未标定，结果供人工复核。</p></div>",
    .report_table(rows),
    "<p class='muted'>证据覆盖率以各自可比较的内容为分母。能唯一配对的短段落和短代码也可计入，重复片段按原文位置去重。</p>",
    if (nzchar(exclusions)) paste0("<p class='muted'>", report_escape(exclusions), "</p>"))
}

.report_conclusion_guide <- function() {
  rows <- data.frame(
    conclusion = c("疑似抄袭", "未检出明显证据", "证据不足"),
    meaning = c(
      "至少一项有效证据达到当前开发规则的较强证据条件，需要人工核查对应片段及共同来源；不能据此认定抄袭。其他模块仍可能受限。",
      "在当前支持范围内，比较内容量满足开发规则要求，且未发现达到规则条件或需要进一步复核的匹配；不代表证明无抄袭。",
      "尚无有效证据触发较强证据条件，同时存在分析受限或失败、内容量不足，或仍需复核的匹配，因此无法给出明确倾向；不等于无抄袭。"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(rows) <- c("候选结论", "含义与使用方式")
  .report_table(rows)
}

detector_report_html <- function(result, max_evidence = 10L) {
  max_evidence <- code_positive_integer(max_evidence, "max_evidence")
  if (max_evidence > 100L) stop("max_evidence must not exceed 100.")
  if (!is.list(result) || !identical(result$verdict, "not_enabled")) stop("Expected an analyze_rmd_pair result.")
  out <- character(); add <- function(...) out <<- c(out, paste0(...))
  section <- function(title, id = NULL) {
    anchor <- if (is.null(id)) "" else paste0(" id='", report_escape(id), "'")
    add("<h2", anchor, ">", report_escape(title), "</h2>")
  }
  note <- function(text) add("<p>", report_escape(text), "</p>")
  module <- function(name) {
    m <- result$modules[[name]]
    note(paste("分析状态：", m$status))
    if (nzchar(m$error)) add("<div class='notice error'>", .report_pre(m$error), "</div>")
    if (length(m$warnings)) add(.report_pre(paste(m$warnings, collapse = "\n")))
    m$value
  }
  trigger_ids <- result$decision$trigger_records$record_id
  records <- result$evidence$value$records
  triggers <- if (length(trigger_ids)) records[match(trigger_ids, records$record_id, nomatch = 0L), , drop = FALSE] else
    empty_evidence_records()
  trigger_cards <- list()
  render_row <- function(row, title, fun) {
    parts <- c("<article class='evidence'><h4>", report_escape(title), "</h4>")
    fun(row, function(...) parts <<- c(parts, paste0(...)))
    paste0(c(parts, "</article>"), collapse = "")
  }
  evidence_rows <- function(module_name, table_name, title, fun) {
    df <- result$modules[[module_name]]$value[[table_name]]
    add("<h3>", report_escape(title), "</h3>")
    if (!nrow(df)) { note("没有达到当前规则的对应条目；这不是无抄袭结论。"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
    selected <- triggers[triggers$module == module_name & triggers$table == table_name, , drop = FALSE]
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(selected))) {
      i <- selected$source_row[j]
      id <- selected$record_id[j]
      trigger_cards[[id]] <<- render_row(df[i, , drop = FALSE], paste(id, title, i), fun)
    }
    ordinary <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), selected$source_row)
    shown <- head(ordinary, max_evidence)
    note(paste0("共 ", nrow(df), " 条，", nrow(selected), " 条触发片段在候选结论下展示；其余展示前 ",
      length(shown), " 条。条目可重叠，不作为独立证据累计。"))
    for (i in shown) add(render_row(df[i, , drop = FALSE], paste(title, i), fun))
  }
  line_pair <- function(row, a, b) .report_pair(a, b,
    paste0("A：第", row$start_line_a, "—", row$end_line_a, "行"),
    paste0("B：第", row$start_line_b, "—", row$end_line_b, "行"))
  add("<div class='detector-report'>")
  add("<section class='report-overview' aria-label='分析结果速览'>")
  section("分析结果速览")
  add(.report_analysis_overview(result))
  if (all(result$manifest$read_status == "ok")) {
    add("<nav class='report-navigation' aria-label='报告章节'>",
      "<a href='#report-text'>文字证据</a><a href='#report-formula'>公式证据</a>",
      "<a href='#report-code'>R 代码证据</a><a href='#report-diagnostics'>分析限制</a></nav>")
  }
  add("</section>")
  trigger_after <- length(out)
  if (!is.null(result$decision)) {
    d <- result$decision
    add("<details class='report-details'><summary>判定规则和技术详情</summary>")
    section("开发规则试判（未标定）")
    note(paste("规则版本：", d$rules$version, "；触发路径：", d$pathway))
    add(.report_pre(paste(d$reasons, collapse = "\n")))
    add(.report_table(d$trigger_records))
    note("以下为两侧当前可比较内容量；公式步骤和公式token只作开发规则的内容量检查，不是公式覆盖率。")
    add(.report_table(d$adequacy))
    add(.report_pre(paste(d$limitations, collapse = "\n")))
    add("<h3>开发规则参数</h3>", .report_table(.report_params(d$rules)), "</details>")
  }
  add("<details class='report-details'><summary>输入与分析概况</summary>")
  note(paste("运行状态：", result$overall_status, "；引擎：", result$engine_version, "；R：", result$r_version))
  add(.report_table(result$manifest))
  labels <- c(text = "文字", formula_single = "完整公式", formula_sequence = "公式步骤", code_whole = "完整代码", code_local = "局部代码")
  statuses <- data.frame(module = unname(labels), status = vapply(result$modules, function(m) m$status, character(1)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  add(.report_table(statuses))
  note("error 表示模块未完成，不能按零相似度处理；limited 表示只分析了支持的范围。not_applicable、insufficient等状态需结合原文核查。")
  add("</details>")
  if (any(result$manifest$read_status != "ok")) {
    note("输入读取失败，本次未运行分项比较。请检查路径、Rmd扩展名及UTF-8编码后重新运行。")
    section("解析诊断与未覆盖内容")
    add("<h3>三种候选结论是什么意思</h3>", .report_conclusion_guide())
    add("</div>"); return(paste(out, collapse = "\n"))
  }
  if (!is.null(result$exclusions) && result$exclusions$status != "not_requested") {
    section("公共来源：明确标注与排除前后")
    note(paste("排除状态：", result$exclusions$status))
    if (!is.null(result$exclusions$reference_name)) {
      note(paste0("公共参考文件为 ", result$exclusions$reference_name,
        "。程序只排除规范化后与参考完全一致的完整单元。"))
    } else {
      note("来源由操作者明确标注。以下正文证据属于排除后范围，原始输入概况和诊断仍保留。")
    }
    if (nzchar(result$exclusions$error)) {
      add("<div class='notice error'>", .report_pre(result$exclusions$error), "</div>")
      note("配置未全部通过核对，没有应用任何一侧的排除；排除后分析未运行。排除前结果仅供核查。")
    }
    if (!is.null(result$baseline_modules)) add(.report_table(rbind(
      .report_scope_summary(result$baseline_modules, "排除前"),
      .report_scope_summary(result$modules, "排除后"))))
    note("排除前后的代码对照表使用局部匹配口径。报告速览另计入符合条件的短代码块。")
    records <- result$exclusions$records
    if (nrow(records)) {
      note(paste("排除记录共", nrow(records), "条；以下最多展示100条，quote最多展示4000字符，完整记录保留在分析结果中。"))
      shown <- utils::head(records, 100L); shown$quote <- substr(shown$quote, 1L, 4000L)
      add(.report_table(shown))
      note("已排除的解析单元（最多展示100行）：")
      add(.report_table(utils::head(result$exclusions$units, 100L)))
    }
    note("排除前后的分母不同，不能只比较覆盖率高低。被排除区域仍作匹配边界，未解析诊断不会因排除自动清空。")
  }
  da <- result$documents$A; db <- result$documents$B
  if (!is.null(result$evidence)) {
    add("<details class='report-details'><summary>查看匹配记录索引</summary>")
    section("证据整理：位置重叠与方法来源")
    note(paste("证据整理状态：", result$evidence$status))
    if (nzchar(result$evidence$error)) add(.report_pre(result$evidence$error))
    e <- result$evidence$value
    if (!is.null(e)) {
      note(paste("原始匹配记录", nrow(e$records), "条；位置分组", nrow(e$groups), "组；仅辅助原文比较", e$support_only_count, "条。以下表格各最多展示100行，完整记录保留在分析结果中。"))
      add(.report_table(utils::head(e$groups, 100L)))
      add(.report_table(utils::head(e$records[, c("record_id", "group_id", "kind", "module", "table", "source_row", "method", "level", "eligible", "matched_units"), drop = FALSE], 100L)))
      if (length(e$issues)) add(.report_pre(paste(e$issues, collapse = "\n")))
      note("同类记录只要在任一侧共享实际位置就归为一组。字符、token和公式步骤分开；分组不是独立性证明，也不产生综合分数。组内可能有不同对应或变量映射，不能将其拼成一个更长匹配；largest_match来自真实代表记录。unique_a/b只表示位置并集，行号范围只是外包范围。")
      note("证据仅来自当前分析范围；启用公共来源排除时，不混入排除前结果。未知语法等仅辅助原文比较不提供有效长度，不触发判定。")
    }
    add("</details>")
  }
  section("文字：字符覆盖与片段", "report-text"); text <- module("text")
  if (!is.null(text)) {
    note(paste("字符片段 Jaccard：", if (is.na(text$jaccard$similarity)) "信息不足" else format(text$jaccard$similarity, digits = 5)))
    note("以下覆盖按实际相同源字符的并集计算；替换字符、插删空位和忽略的排版标记不计覆盖。行号区间不等于整段均匹配。")
    add(.report_table(if (is.null(text$coverage_with_short)) text$coverage else text$coverage_with_short))
    evidence_rows("text", "exact_matches", "精确文字片段", function(row, add) {
      add(.report_table(row[, c("matched_chars", "start_line_a", "end_line_a", "start_line_b", "end_line_b"), drop = FALSE]))
      add(line_pair(row, .report_source(da, row$source_positions_a[[1L]]), .report_source(db, row$source_positions_b[[1L]])))
    })
    if (identical(text$approximate_status, "resource_limit")) {
      note("近似文字匹配超出资源上限，文字覆盖仅基于已完成的精确匹配。")
      add(.report_pre(text$approximate_error))
    } else {
      evidence_rows("text", "approximate_matches", "近似文字片段", function(row, add) {
        add(.report_table(row[, c("equal_chars", "alignment_columns", "similarity"), drop = FALSE]))
        add(line_pair(row, .report_source(da, row$aligned_positions_a[[1L]]), .report_source(db, row$aligned_positions_b[[1L]])))
      })
    }
    if (!is.null(text$short_matches)) evidence_rows("text", "short_matches", "短段落补充匹配", function(row, add) {
      add(.report_table(row[, c("equal_chars", "similarity"), drop = FALSE]))
      add(line_pair(row, row$text_a, row$text_b))
    })
